G1536 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=36.5 grams |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=March 30th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=October 2024 |ReleaseCA=January 6th, 2025 |AttackStat=70 |DefenseStat=20 |StaminaStat=10 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''DranBuster'''|ドランバスター|DoranBasutā}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Unique Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-01 Starter, [[DranBuster 1-60A]], on March 30th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as '''Buster Dran''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Buster Dran 1-60A]]. ==Description== '''DranBuster''' is an Attack Type Blade with an overall blocky shape. The Gear Chip features [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Seiryū]] [[wikipedia:Dragon Fire|shooting a fireball]]. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''DranBuster''' has resin Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: a "large broadsword" tip-like protrusion on the bottom of '''DranBuster''' acts as the primary contact point and namesake. This creates an imbalanced weight distribution, with the weight being concentrated at the protrusion. This results in the ability for '''DranBuster''' to perform a {{Translation|"''[[wiktionary:one-hit kill|One Hit Kill]]''"|一撃必殺|Ichigeki Hissatsu}}, delivering a powerful blow with the protrusion. As a result of its shape, '''DranBuster''' has high Burst Attack and Knockout (KO) Attack. '''DranBuster''' is intended to be used in tandem with the [[Ratchet - 1-60|1-60]] Ratchet and [[Bit - Accel|Accel]] Bit. The 1-60 Ratchet has an imbalanced design that matches the weight distribution of '''DranBuster'''. The Accel Bit increases the speed of an [[Xtreme Dash]], causing heavier hits. Only one side of the sword tip protrusion makes contact with the opponent's Bey; consequently, this contact area will dent and chip over time. It is thus recommended to have several copies of '''DranBuster''' for competitive usage. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *BX-48 [[Random Booster Vol. 9]] - 05: [[DranBuster 2-80Q]] (Metal Coat: Red Minor Change Version) *CX-08 [[Random Booster Vol. 7]] - 04: [[DranBuster 5-80MN]] *UX-01 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] *UX-04 [[Battle Entry Set U]] - [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Special Ver.) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Red) *UX-00 [[Dran Deck Starter]] - [[DranBuster 3-70N]] (Metal Coat: White) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Blue FC Barcelona Ver.) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Black) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Cyan) *UX-00 [[DranBuster 1-60A]] (Metal Coat: Violet) ===Hasbro=== *G1536 [[Buster Dran 1-60A]] *G1751 [[Buster Dran 5-70DB]] *G3611 [[Buster Dran 5-70DB]] ==Gallery== BladeDranBuster.png|DranBuster (UX-01/G1536) DranBuster 1-60A (Special Ver.).jpg|DranBuster (Special Ver.) G2742 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=41.4 grams |System=Basic Line |System2=Expand Blade |Series=Beyblade X (Season 3) |ReleaseJP=May 16th, 2026 |ReleaseUS=July 15th, 2026 |AttackStat=58 |DefenseStat=25 |StaminaStat=17 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''DranStrike'''|ドランストライク|DoranSutoraiku}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Basic Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-49 Starter, [[DranStrike 4-50FF]], on May 16th, 2026. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Infinity Starter Pack, [[Strike Dran 4-50FF]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Its six heavyweight blades are made more stable by the metal extending into the center, allowing for strong barrage attacks. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Strike Dran''' (Japanese: '''DranStrike''') is an Attack Type Blade with a six-sided design. The contact points are composed of 2 sets of 3 "wings", with the smaller wings protruding from the gaps between the larger wings. The design is similar to that of its predecessor, [[Blade - DranDagger|DranDagger (Dagger Dran)]], albeit with a more pronounced difference in wing lengths. The Gear Chip features [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Seiryū]] [[wikipedia:Dragon Fire|exhaling fire]]. [[Basic Line]] (BX) Blades have metal Launcher Hooks, which increases weight towards the center of the Blade. As part of the ''[[Expand Blade]]'' (''Infinity'') lineup, the Expanded feature of '''DranStrike''' is the extension of the metal beyond the Launcher Hooks, with the perimeter of the Gear Chip being made of metal. In the case of '''DranStrike''', the design intention is to increase [[Smash Attack]] capabilities. At the time of its release, '''DranStrike''' was the heaviest [[Basic Line]] (BX) Blade, at an average weight of 41.4 grams. It was also the heaviest non-[[Custom Line]] (CX) Blade, with the heaviest CX Blade combinations weighing about 5 grams more. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *BX-49 [[DranStrike 4-50FF]] ===Hasbro=== *G2742 [[Strike Dran 4-50FF]] ==Gallery== BladeDranStrike.png|DranStrike (BX-49/G2742) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-01 Starter, [[DranSword 3-60F]], on June 10th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries as '''Sword Dran''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Sword Dran 3-60F]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Using 3 upper blades, it launches its opponent upward diagonally. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Sword Dran''' (Japanese: '''DranSword''') is a three-sided Attack Type Blade with three upward slanting blades acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Seiryū]] [[wikipedia:Dragon Fire|exhaling fire]]. '''DranSword''' was one of the first four Blades released, and was the first Attack Type Blade released. It was popular in [[3on3 Battle]] decks and remained heavily used from its release in June 2023 until January 2024, when it was gradually replaced by the heavier [[Blade - PhoenixWing|PhoenixWing (Soar Phoenix)]] Blade. During those 6 months, it also competed with the [[Blade - SharkEdge|SharkEdge (Keel Shark)]] Blade, which offered superior Attack potential, but less Stamina. '''DranSword''' also suffered from a wear issue, as the three upper blades would gradually wear down and become more blunt, reducing its [[Smash Attack]]. In addition, the metal components were known to shatter in some cases. Releases of '''DranSword''' produced during January 2024 onward (including all Hasbro releases of '''Sword Dran''') have a new reinforced mold that weighs over 35 grams. This second mold was first released with the ''Sushiro Version'' release, and is superior in performance, with less breakage issues. However, it retains the aforementioned wear issue, as the three upper blades remain unchanged. ==Overall== Although a strong release at the beginning of the toyline, '''DranSword''' has subsequently been replaced by heavier Attack Type Blades. F9584 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Balance |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=27.7 grams |System=Basic Line |System2=X-Over Project |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=July 15th, 2023 |ReleaseUS=June 1st, 2024 |ReleaseCA=May 30th, 2024 |ReleaseAU=May 16th, 2024 |AttackStat=35 |DefenseStat=30 |StaminaStat=35 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''DranzerSpiral'''|ドランザースパイラル|DoranzāSupairaru}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Basic Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-00 Booster, [[DranzerSpiral 3-80T]], on July 15th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Dranzer Spiral 3-80T]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Designed with a focus on Balance, it features two horizontal blades that produce high striking power and Stamina. |speaker = Official Description}} '''DranzerSpiral''' is Balance Type Blade and [[X-Over Project]] adaptation of the [[Bit Chip - Dranzer|Dranzer]] Bit Chip, [[Attack Ring - Double Wing|Double Wing]] Attack Ring, and [[Weight Disk - Eight Balance|Eight Balance]] Weight Disk that came with the [[Original Series]]' [[Spin Gear System]] Beyblade, [[Dranzer S]]. Due to the design of the system, the Blade is not customizable and is a single piece that cannot be separated. As such, its main contact points are two long blades that enable [[Upper Attack]], based on those of the Double Wing Attack Ring. Parts resembling the Eight Balance Weight Disk act as additional contact points. The Gear Chip features the Dranzer Bit Beast, based on the original Bit Chip design. Like other X-Over Project Blades, '''DranzerSpiral''' has polycarbonate plastic Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones. '''DranzerSpiral''' is the lightest Blade released at 27.7 grams, weighing 4 to 7 grams less than the other Blades released on the same date. The light weight allows a '''DranzerSpiral''' to move at high speeds when used with a flat tip Bit such as [[Bit - Flat|Flat]] and [[Bit - Rush|Rush]]. However, the light weight also creates very low Stamina, and less [[Smash Attack]] than other Attack Type Blades such as [[Blade - SharkEdge|SharkEdge]]. ==Overall== Despite its high speeds, the light weight of '''DranzerSpiral''' makes it outclassed by other Attack Type Blades. Furthermore, it is too light to be used in Defense and Stamina combinations. '''As such, DranzerSpiral is not recommended for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-00 [[DranzerSpiral 3-80T]] * BX-00 [[DranzerSpiral 3-80T]] (Black Ver.) G1752 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Balance |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=33.0 grams |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=March 30th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=March 7th, 2025 |ReleaseCA=March 13th, 2025 |ReleaseEU=February 2025 |AttackStat=50 |DefenseStat=25 |StaminaStat=25 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''HellsHammer'''|ヘルズハンマー|Heruzu Hanmā}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Unique Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-02 Starter, [[HellsHammer 3-70H]], on March 30th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as '''Hammer Incendio''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Hammer Incendio 3-70H]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Its thick Smash Blades specialize in blasting opponents into the Stadium floor. |speaker = Official Description}} '''HellsHammer''' is a right-spin Balance Type Blade with three "Smash Blades" acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features a flaming skull representing the [[wikipedia:Death (personification)|Grim Reaper]]. Despite its Balance Type classification by Takara Tomy, '''HellsHammer''' has a very aggressive Attack Type Blade design. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''HellsHammer''' has resin Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: the three-sided shape and aggressive design of the "Smash Blades" create high amounts of [[Smash Attack]] and [[Force Smash]] (downward Smash Attack). '''HellsHammer''' is intended to be used in tandem with the [[Bit - Hexa|Hexa]] Bit. The Hexa Bit increases the frequency of Force Smash by uprighting a '''HellsHammer''' combination and then tilting it downward. Consequently, a '''HellsHammer''' combination "smashes down repeatedly like a hammer", hence the Blade's name. Its initial mold could unintentionally be launched in left-spin. Subsequent releases by Takara Tomy and Hasbro have a modified mold that adds extra metal to prevent this, slightly increasing the Blade's weight by half a gram. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *CX-17 [[Random Booster Vol. 10]] - 04: [[HellsHammer 3-85GU]] *UX-02 [[HellsHammer 3-70H]] *UX-10 [[Customize Set U]] (Metal Coat: Blue) *UX-00 [[Bey Kick Off Set]] - [[HellsHammer 3-70H]] (Metal Coat: Red FC Barcelona Ver.) ===Hasbro=== *G1752 [[Hammer Incendio 3-70H]] *G3195 [[X-treme Expansion Pack]] (Metal Coat: Blue) ==Gallery== BladeHellsHammer.png|HellsHammer (UX-02/G1752) HellsHammer (Metal Coat Blue).png|HellsHammer (Metal Coat: Blue; UX-10/G3195) HellsHammer 3-85GU.png|HellsHammer (CX-17) HellsHammer 3-70H (Metal Coat Red FC Barcelona Ver.).png|HellsHammer (Metal Coat: Red FC Barcelona Ver.) ==Trivia== *Despite its Balance Type labeling, '''HellsHammer''' has Attack Type stats. **Hasbro's G1752 Starter Pack release erroneously labels '''HellsHammer''' as an Attack Type Blade. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]] [[Category:Parts with multiple molds]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-02 Starter, [[HellsScythe 4-60T]], on June 10th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries as '''Scythe Incendio''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Scythe Incendio 4-60T]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Excels at taking on many different opponents with its four smashing blades. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Scythe Incendio''' (Japanese: '''HellsScythe''') is a round four-sided Balance Type Blade with four blades acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features a flaming skull representing the [[wikipedia:Death (personification)|Grim Reaper]]. The round shape creates excellent Stamina and '''HellsScythe''' is among the heaviest non-Attack Type Blades released. Its high Stamina and heavy weight has made it a popular choice in Stamina combinations, often paired with the [[Bit - Ball|Ball (B)]] Bit. The high performance and relatively low [[wiktionary:skill floor|skill floor]] of '''HellsScythe''' Stamina combinations has led to frequent top placements in tournaments since its release. While '''HellsScythe''' has excellent raw Stamina, it suffers from high recoil due to the gaps in its four blades. As such, '''HellsScythe''' has low Knockout (KO) Defense, although this recoil can also knock back Attackers into the Over or Xtreme Zones. '''HellsScythe''' also has a small amount of [[Smash Attack]], which allows it to be used in [[Anti-Attack]] Balance combinations. Releases of '''HellsScythe''' produced during June 2025 onward have a new reinforced mold with four square plastic tabs on the underside of the Blade. The addition of these tabs reduces the imbalance of the Blade, making it more stable. The tabs also increase the overall Blade weight by about 1 gram. ==Overall== Although a top-tier Stamina Blade at the beginning of the toyline, and for many months afterward, '''HellsScythe''' has since been outclassed by the likes of WizardRod and SilverWolf. '''As such, HellsScythe is not recommended for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-02 [[HellsScythe 4-60T]] (red) * BX-08 [[3on3 Deck Set]] - [[HellsScythe 3-80B]] (yellow) * BX-14 [[Random Booster Vol. 1]] - 05: [[HellsScythe 4-80LF]] (green) * BX-48 [[Random Booster Vol. 9]] - 04: [[HellsScythe 3-85GB]] (Metal Coat: Gold Minor Change Version) (gold) * BX-00 [[HellsScythe 4-60T]] (Metal Coat: Gold) (gold) * BX-00 [[HellsScythe 3-80F]] (SP X Bey) (blue) ===Hasbro=== * F9583 [[Scythe Incendio 4-60T]] * G0285 [[Scythe Incendio 3-80B]] ==Gallery== BladeHellsScythe.png|HellsScythe (BX-02; Official Image) HellsScythe (BX-08).png|HellsScythe (BX-08) HellsScythe 4-80LF.png|HellsScythe (BX-14) HellsScythe 4-60T (Metal Coat Gold).jpg|HellsScythe (Metal Coat: Gold) HellsScythe 3-80F.jpg|HellsScythe (BX-00) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]] [[Category:Parts with multiple molds]]

parts.title: Blade - ImpactDrake
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=BladeImpactDrake.png |Name=ImpactDrake |JPName=インパクトドレイク |RomajiName=InpakutoDoreiku |ProductCode=UX-11 (Takara Tomy)
G0842 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=39.0 grams |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=December 28th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=May 2025 |ReleaseCA=May 2025 |ReleaseAU=May 2025 |AttackStat=75 |DefenseStat=25 |StaminaStat=10 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''ImpactDrake'''|インパクトドレイク|InpakutoDoreiku}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Unique Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-11 Starter, [[ImpactDrake 9-60LR]], on December 28th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Drop Attack Battle Set]]. ==Description== '''ImpactDrake''' is an Attack Type Blade with four blades acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features the side profile of the [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Blue Dragon (Seiryū)]], one of the [[wikipedia:Four Symbols|Four Auspicious Beasts]] from Chinese mythology. Like the other Team Pendragon Beyblades, the Gear Chip has the ''Bakuten Shoot Beyblade'' logo, in this case being on the dragon's neck. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''ImpactDrake''' has rubber Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: each of the four blades have rubber dragon heads. The 4 primary contact points are located where the end of the rubber dragon heads meet the metal portion of the blades. At the time of its release, '''ImpactDrake''' was the heaviest Blade available, weighing 39 grams on average. The aggressive shape of the jagged contact points creates extremely high Burst Attack and Knockout (KO) Attack. However, these contact points will wear down with use, with the metal denting in a manner similar to the wear issues of the [[Blade - DranSword|DranSword]] Blade. The rubber dragon heads will also dent and chip, increasing contact with the metal portion of the blades. It is thus recommended to have several copies of '''ImpactDrake''' for competitive usage. ==Overall== '''ImpactDrake''''s heavy weight and excellent Burst/Smash Attack makes it one of the strongest Attack Type Blades, in terms of raw attacking strength. '''As such, ImpactDrake is a must-have for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-50 [[Random Booster Vol. 11]] - 03: [[ImpactDrake 7-55FB]] * UX-11 [[ImpactDrake 9-60LR]] ===Hasbro=== * G0842 [[Drop Attack Battle Set]] - [[Impact Drake 9-60LR]] ==Gallery== BladeImpactDrake.png|ImpactDrake (UX-11) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-04 Starter, [[KnightShield 3-80N]], on July 15th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries as '''Helm Knight''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Helm Knight 3-80N]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Its six defensive blades create an impact dampening structure, easily absorbing attacks. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Helm Knight''' (Japanese: '''KnightShield''') is a round Defense Type Blade with six main contact points. The Gear Chip features a [[wikipedia:Knight|knight]] wearing a [[wikipedia:Close helmet|close helm]]. '''KnightShield''' was one of the first four Blades released, and was the first Defense Type Blade released. The original weight of '''KnightShield''' averaged 32.4 grams, slightly less than its contemporary, HellsScythe (Scythe Incendio), which averaged 33.0 grams. '''KnightShield''' was popular in [[3on3 Battle]] decks and was common in decks from its release in June 2023 until March 2024, when it was immediately outclassed by the heavier [[Blade - WizardRod|WizardRod (Wand Wizard)]] Blade. WizardRod, which had a similar shape and use, eventually replaced both '''KnightShield''' and HellsScythe for Defense and Stamina combos. Releases of '''KnightShield''' produced during January 2025 onward (which all have a clear coat) have a new reinforced mold that weighs 34.8 grams on average. This second mold was first released with Takara Tomy and Hasbro reprints of the original BX-04/F9581 [[KnightShield 3-80N]]. '''KnightShield''' is the base design for several retools: [[Blade - Iron Man|Iron Man]], [[Blade - Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]], [[Blade - Optimus Prime|Optimus Prime]], and [[Blade - Bumblebee|Bumblebee]]. The retools weigh less than '''KnightShield''', and have worse balancing and contact points. ==Overall== Although a competitive release at the beginning of the toyline, '''KnightShield''' has subsequently been replaced by heavier Defense and Stamina Type Blades. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-00 [[Random Booster Lightning L-Drago 1-60F]] on September 14th, 2024.

==Description==<!--
{{QuotePart
|quote =
|speaker = Official Description}}-->
<onlyinclude>"Lightning L-Drago" can refer to 2 left-spin Attack Type Blades and [[X-Over Project]] adaptations of the [[Face Bolt - L-Drago I|L-Drago I Face]], [[Energy Ring - L-Drago I|L-Drago I Clear Wheel]], and [[Fusion Wheel - Lightning|Lightning Metal Wheel]] that came with the [[Metal Series]]' [[Hybrid Wheel System]] Beyblade, [[Lightning L-Drago 100HF]]. Due to the design of the system, the Blade parts are not customizable. As a result, the "Lightning L-Drago" Blades lack the mode change gimmick of the original parts, instead separating the Upper and Rapid-Hit Modes as two separate Blades: the "[[Blade - Lightning L-Drago (Upper Type)|Lightning L-Drago (Upper Type)]]" Blade and the "'''Lightning L-Drago (Rapid-Hit Type)'''" Blade. Like the original parts' Rapid-Hit Mode, the '''Lightning L-Drago (Rapid-Hit Type)''' Blade has three sets of three ridged protrusions that act as the main contact points, which can be used for rapid attacks.

Both "Lightning L-Drago" Blades are unstable due to each of the three contact points being hollowed differently. The instability creates highly inconsistent and erratic movement, causing shaking and wobbling that drains Stamina. While the Upper Type has a higher weight than the Rapid-Hit Type on average, the slight difference in shape means the Upper Type is more favorable for Attack.

===Rulings===
Official tournaments held by [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) treat both "Lightning L-Drago" Blades as the same Blade.<ref name="YouTube">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yTZLV18XcL8 Official video]</ref> As such, only 1 of the 2 "Lightning L-Drago" Blades can be used in a [[3on3 Battle]] deck.<ref name="YouTube"/> In addition, they cannot be swapped with each other during a Match, as parts cannot be exchanged between Battles after Bey checks.<ref name="Regulations">[https://takaratomyasia.com/img/beybladex/1723513726_Regulation%20ver.5%20English%20ver..pdf BEYBLADE X Regulations 5th edition]</ref>

Ranked tournaments held by the [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) use the same ruling.<ref name="Sep17">[https://worldbeyblade.org/Thread-WBO-Organized-Play-Updates-September-2024-X-Spreadsheets-Lightning-Blades-and-More WBO Organized Play Updates September 2024]</ref></onlyinclude>

parts.title: Blade - LusterDragoon
parts.text: {{Part Infobox |Image=BladeLusterDragoon.png |Name=LusterDragoon |JPName=ラスタードラグーン |RomajiName=RasutāDoragūn |AKA= |ProductCode=BX-52 (Takara Tomy) |Classification=Blade |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Left-Spin |Weight=43.0 grams |System=Basic Line |System2=Expand Blade |Series=Beyblade X (Season 4) |ReleaseJP=October 10th, 2026 |ReleaseUS= |AttackStat=75 |DefenseStat=15 |StaminaStat=10 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''LusterDragoon'''|ラスタードラグーン|RasutāDoragūn}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Basic Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-52 Starter, [[LusterDragoon 6-60LC]], on October 10th, 2026. ==Description== '''LusterDragoon''' is a left-spin Attack Type Blade with a two-sided aggressive design. It is the third left-spin and "Dragoon" Blade in the toyline, following its predecessors [[Blade - CobaltDragoon|CobaltDragoon]] and [[Blade - MeteorDragoon|MeteorDragoon]]. The Bit insertion point is off-center, creating an uneven center of gravity, which in theory increases Attack strength. Like its predecessors, '''LusterDragoon''' references the Dragoon Beyblades from ''[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade]]''. The Gear Chip features the side profile of the [[wikipedia:Azure Dragon|Blue Dragon (Seiryū)]], one of the [[wikipedia:Four Symbols|Four Auspicious Beasts]] from Chinese mythology. The ''Bakuten Shoot Beyblade'' logo is located on the neck, as with previous Gear Chip designs in the line. It also features design cues from Beyblades from ''[[Metal Fight Beyblade]]'', in this case being the L-Drago line of Beyblades, as well as [[Ronin Dragoon LW160BSF]]. The Gear Chip has a purple diamond/hexagonal shape in the background that referencing "Face" parts from the ''Metal Fight Beyblade'' toyline. In addition, it references the "Longinus" line of Beyblades from ''[[Beyblade Burst]]'', with its two-sided shape and Launcher Hooks resembling [[Lost Longinus Nine Spiral]]. In addition to having a similar heavy metal gimmick, '''LusterDragoon''' is the only BX Expand Blade without a perfect circular Gear Chip sticker; thus generic stickers cannot be used. [[Basic Line]] (BX) Blades have metal Launcher Hooks, which increases weight towards the center of the Blade. As part of the ''[[Expand Blade]]'' (''Infinity'') lineup, the Expanded feature of '''LusterDragoon''' is the extension of the metal beyond the Launcher Hooks, with the perimeter of the Gear Chip being made of metal. At the time of its release, '''LusterDragoon''' was the heaviest [[Basic Line]] (BX) Blade, at an average weight of 42.8 grams. It was also the heaviest non-[[Custom Line]] (CX) Blade, with the heaviest CX Blade combinations weighing about 5 grams more. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-52 [[LusterDragoon 6-60LC]] ==Gallery== BladeLusterDragoon.png|LusterDragoon (BX-52) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]]

It debuted in western countries with the release of the [[Optimus Primal and Starscream Multipack Set]]. It later debuted with in Japan with the release of [[Takara Tomy]]'s BX-00 [[Optimus Primal and Starscream Multipack Set]] on May 17th, 2025. ==Description== '''Optimus Primal''' is an Attack Type Blade with two large blades acting as the main contact points. '''Optimus Primal''' is a retool of [[Blade - SharkEdge|SharkEdge (Keel Shark)]]; the plastic components are identical, and the metal component is nearly identical. Besides the changes in textures, the tips of the large blades are slightly rounded and stubbier. The two large blades produce [[Smash Attack]] and [[Upper Attack]], due to their aggressive, upward sloping shapes. '''Optimus Primal''' is one of the few retools to weigh more than what it was based on, with an average weight equal or surpassing that of SharkEdge. The Gear Chip features [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Optimus_Primal_(BW) Optimus Primal], a Maximal officer from ''Beast Wars: Transformers''. The design is based on his [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Evergreen evergreen character design], with the Gear Chip directly being taken from an existing art asset. The texture found on the two large blades may be a reference to Optimus Primal's swords, with the Launcher Hooks resembling his robot mode chestplate design. ==Overall== '''Optimus Primal''' is nearly identical to that of SharkEdge, but has two additional advantages: first, it is heavier, and second, the rounded tips of the blades are less likely to chip and become damaged. As '''Optimus Primal''' retains SharkEdge's excellent Attack capabilities, it can be used interchangeably with SharkEdge, or provide an additional SharkEdge in a deck. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-23 Starter, [[PhoenixWing 9-60GF]], on December 10th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries as '''Soar Phoenix''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Soar Phoenix Deluxe String Launcher Set]]. ==Description== '''Soar Phoenix''' (Japanese: '''PhoenixWing''') is a three-sided Attack Type Blade with three blades acting as the main contact points. The Gear Chip features the [[wikipedia:Phoenix (mythology)|phoenix]] spreading its wings. The three blades slope upwards, creating [[Upper Attack]]. At the start of each of the three blades is a protruding "Launcher Hook" - unlike other Blades, '''PhoenixWing''''s Launcher Hooks protrude past the perimeter of the Blade, creating contact points. When lined up with the three larger protrusions of the [[Ratchet - 9-60|9-60]] Ratchet, this creates "Attack Points" with high amounts of [[Smash Attack]]. The rest of the blades consist of two smaller bumps, which also act as contact points, creating high Smash Attack as well. At the time of its release, '''PhoenixWing''', along with another painted "Metal Coat" Blade [[Blade - CobaltDrake|CobaltDrake]], was the heaviest Blade at an average weight of 38.0 grams. It was surpassed 7 months later with the release of [[Blade - AeroPegasus|AeroPegasus]]. However, any releases of '''PhoenixWing''' produced during October 2024 onward have a new reinforced mold that weighs 39.0 grams on average. This second mold was first released with [[PhoenixWing 9-80DB]], and was later included with reprints of [[PhoenixWing 9-60GF]] and [[PhoenixWing 5-80H]]. This second mold was the heaviest Blade at its release in November 2024, before being matched/surpassed a month later by heavy copies of [[Blade - ImpactDrake|ImpactDrake]] weighing 39.4 grams. At 38.0-39.3 grams, '''PhoenixWing''' is heavier than most Defense and Stamina Blades. Combined with its aggressive shape, '''PhoenixWing''' is highly versatile, and can be used on flat Bits such as [[Bit - Low Flat|Low Flat (LF)]] and [[Bit - Rush|Rush (R)]] for a powerful Attack combination, or on Bits such as [[Bit - Ball|Ball (B)]] and [[Bit - Needle|Needle (N)]] for Balance combinations. Alternatively, [[Bit - Point|Point (P)]] and [[Bit - Taper|Taper (T)]] have been popular alternatives as well for Attack combinations. At the time of writing, '''PhoenixWing''' and the Rush Bit have been heavily used together in [[Beyblade Battle Base|B4]] and [[WBO]] tournaments since its release. ==Overall== '''PhoenixWing''''s heavy weight and excellent Attack capabilities make it a staple Blade. {{Part Infobox |Image=BladeScorpioSpear.png |Name=ScorpioSpear |JPName=スコーピオスピア |RomajiName=SukōpioSupia |AKA=Spear Scorpio (Hasbro) |ProductCode=UX-14 (Takara Tomy)
G2758 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Balance |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=39.6 grams |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X (Season 2) |ReleaseJP=April 26th, 2025 |ReleaseUS=June 19th, 2026 |ReleaseCA=July 15th, 2026 |AttackStat=25 > 55 |DefenseStat=55 > 25 |StaminaStat=30 > 30 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''ScorpioSpear'''|スコーピオスピア|SukōpioSupia}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Unique Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-14 Starter, [[ScorpioSpear 0-70Z]], on April 26th, 2025. It later debuted in western countries as '''Spear Scorpio''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Spear Scorpio and Tail Viper Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote=When it Xtreme Dashes, it transforms from a circular 6-bladed design with high deflection performance into a 3-bladed design with high attack performance. |speaker=Official Description}} '''ScorpioSpear''' is a Balance Type Blade with 3 main metal contact points and 3 plastic sub-layer contact points. The Gear Chip features a [[wikipedia:Scorpion|scorpion]]. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''ScorpioSpear''' has resin Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: when a '''ScorpioSpear''' combo performs a [[Xtreme Dash]], the rotation of the combo's Bit will turn the mechanism of '''ScorpioSpear''', rotating a movable sub-layer. This sub-layer sits between the gaps of the metal contact points at the start of the battle, which is intended to create a rounder 6-sided Defense-type shape. The intention of the gimmick is to change into a more aggressive 3-sided Attack-type shape after an Xtreme Dash to deliver a powerful hit. At the time of its release, '''ScorpioSpear''' was the heaviest Blade at an average weight of 39.6 grams. Its weight surpassed that of [[Blade - PhoenixWing|PhoenixWing]] and [[Blade - ImpactDrake|ImpactDrake]], which were the only two previous Blades to exceed 39 grams. Its shape and heavy weight allowed '''ScorpioSpear''' to immediately become a staple competitive Blade, reaching a high adoption rate and disrupting the metagame, the last Blade doing so being [[Blade - SilverWolf|SilverWolf]], released 6 months prior. ===Rulings=== The transformation mechanism must be reset after each battle. It is not physically possible to launch '''ScorpioSpear''' in its transformed Attack-type shape. ==Overall== Due to its heavy weight and large, round contact points, '''ScorpioSpear''' can be used in Stamina and Balance Type combos, particularly those focused on destabilization of the opponent. It is most commonly used with Stamina Bits such as [[Bit - Ball|Ball (B)]] and [[Bit - Free Ball|Free Ball (FB)]], and [[Bit - Hexa|Hexa (H)]], as well as various Attack Bits such as [[Bit - Rush|Rush (R)]] and [[Bit - Point|Point (P)]] for Balance-type [[Anti-Attack]] combos. ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * UX-14 [[ScorpioSpear 0-70Z]] ===Hasbro=== * G2758 [[Spear Scorpio and Tail Viper Dual Pack]] - [[Spear Scorpio 0-70Z]] ==Gallery== BladeScorpioSpear.png|ScorpioSpear (UX-14/G2758) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: there is a free-spinning ring at the bottom of the Blade, which is intended to deflect Attacks and reduce Stamina loss when struck. ===Breakage=== Compared to other Blades, '''SilverWolf''' has a higher number of breakage reports, with common breaks being either one of the contact points of the metal component shattering and separating, or the black plastic component cracking, causing the entire Blade to fall apart. As such, competitive Bladers seeking to use '''SilverWolf''' should own multiple copies. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *UX-08 [[SilverWolf 3-80FB]] (silver) *UX-21 [[HellsNether Deck Set]] - [[SilverWolf 9-70R]] (Metal Coat: Violet; violet) ===Hasbro=== *G1674 [[Sterling Wolf 3-80FB]] (silver; UX-08 model) *G3084 [[Rival Rumble Pack]] - [[Sterling Wolf 3-80FB]] (silver; UX-08 model) ==Gallery== BladeSilverWolf.png|SilverWolf (UX-08/G1674/G3084) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

BX-00 (Takara Tomy) |Classification=Blade |Type=Stamina |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=33.0 grams |System=Basic Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseUS=July 2024 |ReleaseCA=October 2024 |ReleaseAU=July 2024 |ReleaseJP=April 26th, 2025 |AttackStat=33 |DefenseStat=17 |StaminaStat=50 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Spider-Man'''|スパイダーマン|Supaidā-Man}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the [[Basic Line]] system. It debuted in western countries with the release of the [[Spider-Man and Venom Multipack Set]]. It later debuted with in Japan with the release of [[Takara Tomy]]'s BX-00 [[Spider-Man and Venom Multipack Set]] on April 26th, 2025. ==Description== '''Spider-Man''' is a Stamina Type Blade with a six-sided design acting as the main contact points. '''Spider-Man''' is a retool of [[Blade - ViperTail|ViperTail (Tail Viper)]], with the same plastic components and a modified metal component. The texture design has been changed to a web design, and the red and blue plastic colors are based on Spider-Man's modern suit colors. Like ViperTail, '''Spider-Man''' uses downward-sloping contact points to attack from above, and destabilize the opponent. In practice, the shape is not aggressive enough, and the weight of '''Spider-Man''' is too low to sufficiently hit the opponent. The second release of '''Spider-Man''' from the [[Spider-Man and Hulk Multipack Set]] is generally heavier than the initial release. The initial release itself has two versions, one produced in 2023 without a clear coat, and one produced in 2024 with the newly standard clear coat varnish finish. There are two Gear Chip designs for the '''Spider-Man''' Blade. The first release is based on a generic evergreen character design inspired by the comics. The second release features the Marvel Cinematic Universe's rendition of Spider-Man, specifically the suit from the ''[[wikipedia:Spider-Man: Brand New Day|Spider-Man: Brand New Day]]'' film, which released the same day as the [[Spider-Man and Hulk Multipack Set]]. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-00 [[Spider-Man and Venom Multipack Set]] - [[Spider-Man 3-60F]] ===Hasbro=== * G0288 [[Spider-Man and Venom Multipack Set]] - [[Spider-Man 3-60F]] * G3064 [[Spider-Man and Hulk Multipack Set]] - [[Spider-Man 6-60R]] ==Gallery== BladeSpiderMan.png|Spider-Man (G0288/BX-00) Spider-Man (BND).png|Spider-Man (G3064) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Hasbro]] [[Category:Takara Tomy]]

It debuted in western countries with the release of the [[Optimus Primal and Starscream Multipack Set]]. It later debuted with in Japan with the release of [[Takara Tomy]]'s BX-00 [[Optimus Primal and Starscream Multipack Set]] on May 17th, 2025. ==Description== '''Starscream''' is a Stamina Type Blade with two blades acting as the main contact points. The plastic components of '''Starscream''' are identical to those of [[Blade - WizardArrow|WizardArrow (Arrow Wizard)]], and the metal component is nearly identical. Compared to Wizard Arrow, which was already a light Blade, '''Starscream''' is noticeably light at an average weight of 29.5 grams, making it the lightest Basic Line Blade that is not in the [[X-Over Project]] toyline. '''Starscream''' also suffers from a poor weight distribution due to the asymmetrical redesign of the Wizard Arrow Blade. The result is a very imbalanced Blade with poor Stamina and low Knockout (KO) resistance. The Gear Chip features [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Starscream_(G1) Starscream], a Decepticon Seeker in the ''Transformers'' franchise. The design is based on his [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Evergreen evergreen character design], with the Gear Chip being cropped from an art asset found in the 2017 "Transformers Evergreen Character Toolkit". His "null ray" weapons are textured into the two blades, with textures resembling his head on one end of the Blade. ==Overall== As a strictly inferior version of Wizard Arrow, '''Starscream''' has little use outside of being a collection piece. '''As such, Starscream is not recommended for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-00 [[Optimus Primal and Starscream Multipack Set]] - [[Starscream 3-80N]] ===Hasbro=== * G0352 [[Optimus Primal and Starscream Multipack Set]] - [[Starscream 3-80N]] ==Gallery== Starscream 3-80N.jpeg|Starscream (G0352/BX-00) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Hasbro]] [[Category:Takara Tomy]]

It debuted in western countries with the release of the Booster Pack, [[Steel Samurai 4-80T]]. It later debuted in Japan as {{Translation|'''SamuraiSteel'''|サムライスチール|SamuraiSuchīru}}[https://chizai-watch.com/t/2024036422 Takara Tomy SamuraiSteel trademark filing]Hasbro's [[Beyblade X App]] files with the release of [[Takara Tomy]]'s BX-00 mail order Booster, [[SamuraiSteel 5-70GF]], on May 15th, 2025. ==Description== '''Steel Samurai''' (Japanese: '''SamuraiSteel''') is a five-sided Balance Type Blade with a pentagonal shape. Each side is comprised of a [[wikipedia:Katana|katana]] sword and two smaller protrusions. The Gear Chip features a [[wikipedia:Samurai|samurai]] wearing a ''[[wikipedia:Kabuto|kabuto]]'' helmet. The plastic components of '''SamuraiSteel''' are identical to those of [[Blade - LeonClaw|LeonClaw (Claw Leon)]] and [[Blade - The Mandalorian|The Mandalorian]]. Compared to the latter two Blades, the five-sided "samurai swords" of '''SamuraiSteel''' have a bumpier perimeter that protrudes. These create aggressive contact points, giving '''SamuraiSteel''' greater [[Smash Attack]] than LeonClaw or The Mandalorian. A second reinforced mold was released with Takara Tomy's BX-00 [[SamuraiSteel 5-70GF]]. This second mold weighs about 1 gram more, making '''SamuraiSteel''' the second retool after [[Blade - Optimus Primal|Optimus Primal]] to surpass what it was based on (LeonClaw). Reprints of Hasbro's Booster Pack release also contain this revised second mold. ==Overall== While '''SamuraiSteel''' has greater Attack capabilities than LeonClaw and The Mandalorian, it is still too light to compete with heavier Blades such as PhoenixWing. '''As such, SamuraiSteel is not recommended for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *BX-00 [[SamuraiSteel 5-70GF]] (Metal Coat: White) ===Hasbro=== *G0188 [[Steel Samurai 4-80T]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== SamuraiSteel 5-70GF.jpg|SamuraiSteel (Metal Coat: White; BX-00) ===Hasbro=== Steel Samurai 4-80T.jpeg|Steel Samurai (G0188) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Hasbro]] [[Category:Takara Tomy]]

G1686 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Balance |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=34.6 grams |System=Basic Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=June 15th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=June 2025 |ReleaseCA=May 21st, 2025 |ReleaseAU=May 2025 |AttackStat=45 |DefenseStat=30 |StaminaStat=25 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''WeissTiger'''|ヴァイスタイガー|VaisuTaigā}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Basic Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-33 Booster, [[WeissTiger 3-60U]], on June 15th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as '''Pearl Tiger''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Pearl Tiger and Gill Shark Dual Pack]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = "Combines three functions with its Upper, Damper, and Smash Blades." |speaker = Official Description}} '''WeissTiger''' is a Balance Type Blade with three different sets of three types of blades. The three types of blades are the Attack Type "Upper Blades", the Defense Type "Damper Blades", and the Stamina Type "Smash Blades"Takara Tomy info sheet. As their names suggest, the "Upper Blades" are intended to give '''WeissTiger''' combinations [[Upper Attack]], and the "Smash Blades" are intended to produce [[Force Smash]] (downward [[Smash Attack]]). The "Damper Blades" have holes between the center and outer edge of the Blade, which are intended to absorb the impact of incoming attacks. Like the other Team [[Pendragon]] Blades, '''WeissTiger''' is a reference to Team [[Bladebreakers]]' Beyblades from ''[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade]]'', in this case being Driger. The Gear Chip features the [[wikipedia:White Tiger (mythology)|White Tiger (Byakko)]], one of the [[wikipedia:Four Symbols|Four Auspicious Beasts]] from Chinese mythology, with ''WeissTiger'' being German for "white tiger". Like the other Team Pendragon Beyblades, the Gear Chip has the ''Bakuten Shoot Beyblade'' logo. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-33 [[WeissTiger 3-60U]] (white) * UX-18 [[Random Booster Vol. 8]] - 06: [[WeissTiger 4-80LR]] (red) ===Hasbro=== * G1686 [[Pearl Tiger and Gill Shark Dual Pack]] - [[Pearl Tiger 3-60U]] (white; BX-33 model) * G2762 [[Coil Orochi and Pearl Tiger Dual Pack]] - [[Pearl Tiger 3-85WB]] (red; UX-18 06 model) * G3084 [[Rival Rumble Pack]] - [[Pearl Tiger 3-60U]] (white; BX-33 model) ==Gallery== BladeWeissTiger.png|WeissTiger (BX-33/G1686/G3084) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Basic Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

G1537 (Hasbro) |Classification=Blade |Type=Stamina |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=35.3 grams |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X (Season 1) |ReleaseJP=March 30th, 2024 |ReleaseUS=October 2024 |ReleaseCA=January 6th, 2025 |AttackStat=15 |DefenseStat=25 |StaminaStat=60 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''WizardRod'''|ウィザードロッド|WizādoRoddo}} is a [[Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Unique Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-03 Booster, [[WizardRod 5-70DB]], on March 30th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as '''Wand Wizard''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Starter Pack, [[Wand Wizard 5-70DB]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = Its five large blades set an outward center of gravity and specialize in maximizing centrifugal force. |speaker = Official Description}} '''Wand Wizard''' (Japanese: '''WizardRod''') is a Stamina Type Blade with a wide circular shape. The Gear Chip features a [[wikipedia:Magician (fantasy)|fantasy wizard]] casting magic. Its names reference the [[wikipedia:Wand|magic wands (magic rods)]] used by wizards to cast magic. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''WizardRod''' has resin Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: '''WizardRod''' has a wider diameter than previously released Blades, increasing Stamina performance. ===Rulings=== '''WizardRod''' was one of six "Limited Parts", part of the "[[Limited Rule]]" implemented by [[B4]] for the "Tobu Zoo Cup" Grade 2 (G2) event, held on June 15th, 2024. The Limited Rule was only used during the qualifying tournament, which was played with the "[[1on1 Battle]]" format. If '''WizardRod''' was used in a combo, the opponent would receive 1 point at the beginning of the match.[https://beyblade.takaratomy.co.jp/beyblade-x/event/g2_tobuzoocup2024.html Tobu Zoo Cup page] On February 15th, 2025, [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) announced that '''WizardRod''' would be added to the "[[Hall of Fame (Beyblade X)|Hall of Fame]]", a list that restricts parts from official B4 tournaments. '''WizardRod''' was banned from [[1on1 Battle]] and [[3-Blader Battle]] matches, with the ban taking effect on April 1st, 2025 with the 7th Edition of the Beyblade X Regulations. '''WizardRod''' could however still be used in [[3on3 Battle]] and [[Team Battle]] matches.[https://twitter.com/tbh_pr/status/1890607541220250013 Twitter post from Beyblade X development team] At the time of writing, the [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) has no similar restrictions for '''WizardRod''', or any part. ==Overall== '''WizardRod''''s heavy weight and round shape make it a staple Blade for Stamina Type combinations. '''As such, WizardRod is a must-have for the WBO's X format.''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-35 [[Random Booster Vol. 4]] - 04: [[WizardRod 1-60R]] * UX-03 [[WizardRod 5-70DB]] * UX-04 [[Battle Entry Set U]] - [[WizardRod 5-70DB]] (Special Ver.) * UX-00 WizardRod (Metal Coat: Gold) ([[Beyblade Battle Base|G3]] Tournament Prize) ===Hasbro=== * G1537 [[Wand Wizard 5-70DB]] * G1538 [[Wand Wizard 1-60R]] ==Gallery== BladeWizardRod.png|WizardRod (UX-03/G1537) WizardRod 5-70DB (Special Ver.).jpg|WizardRod (Special Ver.; UX-04) WizardRod (BX-35 04).png|WizardRod (BX-35 04/G1538) WizardRod (Metal Coat Gold).png|WizardRod (Metal Coat: Gold; UX-00) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

[[Beybattle Pass]] |JpVoice = Kazuki Furuta |EnVoice = [[Wikipedia:Zeno Robinson|Zeno Robinson]] |AppearAnime = [[Beyblade X - Episode 41|The Three Masks]] |AppearManga = [[Beyblade X - Chapter 13|Battle at the Top (Part 1)]] }}'''Ciel Kaminari''', known as {{Translation|'''Shieru Kaminari'''|神成シエル|Kaminari Shieru}} in Japan, is a character in the anime/manga series, ''[[Beyblade X]]''. He originally fights with his Beyblade, [[BlackShell 4-60D|Obsidian Shell 4-60D]]. He would adopt the alter ego '''Blader Z''' or {{Translation|'''Kamen Z'''|仮面 {{Ruby|Z|ゼット}}|Kamen Zetto|Mask Z}} in Japan, after being recruited by Khrome to replace [[Jaxon Cross]] as Team [[Pendragon]]'s new member. After Pendragon's victory against [[Persona]], Ciel would later be given a set of [[ShelterDrake 7-80GP|3]] [[ShelterDrake 5-70O|Shelter]] [[ShelterDrake 3-60D|Drakes]] from [[Packun]], now vowing to surpass Khrome. He now mainly fights with his Beyblade, [[ShelterDrake 7-80GP|Shelter Drake 7-80GP]]. ==Appearance== Ciel is an average-sized boy with green eyes with yellow lightning bolts, and spiky orange hair. With two bangs shaped liked lightning bolts, he wears a lime green headband and a gray shirt with elbow sleeves with an orange strip running down from the shoulder, over his shirt he wears a shoulder pack. He wears black trouser with pattern reminiscent of a turtle shell and an orange stripe on the side, and gray sneakers with yellow laces with gray and yellow soles. When he was Blader Z, he wears a gray mask with a horn sticking out of the right side, a black lens with a gear pattern on the lens, and an orange "Z" at the center of the lens. The mask also has a voice filter and a cellphone connection to Khrome. ==Personality== Ciel Kaminari is the former "King of Amateurs"—an undefeated amateur prodigy with strong skills and agility—who joins Team Pendragon as the masked Blader Z. Deeply idolizing leader Khrome Ryugu, he starts as a confident (sometimes arrogant) imitator willing to erase his own identity for his mentor. A crushing loss and Khrome's manipulative expectations lead to mental struggles, jealousy, and a depressive phase after Khrome's absence. Through battles and advice from others, Ciel develops into a more self-aware Blader who aims to surpass his idol on his own terms rather than just copying him. His personality evolves from cocky talent to a troubled, loyal follower, and finally toward passionate independence—making him one of the series' characters with notable growth and depth. He represents the pressure of living up to expectations while searching for a personal Blading style. ==Biography== Ciel Kaminari is the former "King of Amateurs," an undefeated amateur Blader (502-0 record) scouted by Khrome Ryugu to join Team Pendragon as a replacement for Jaxon Cross/Blader X. Out of deep loyalty and admiration for Khrome, he erases his own identity to become the masked Blader Z, embracing a supportive yet pressured role in the pro scene. His journey includes crushing defeats (especially to Robin Kazami), internal struggles with jealousy, inadequacy, and the weight of expectations, followed by personal growth as he removes his mask and strives to find his own Blading path while aiming to surpass his idol. Starting with defensive Beys like Obsidian Shell and evolving to Shelter Drake, Ciel represents themes of idolization, identity crisis, and self-discovery in the competitive world of Beyblade X. He remains a dynamic character with notable development across the series. ===Background=== Ciel Kaminari comes from a relatively ordinary background as a highly talented amateur Blader with no notable family ties mentioned in the series. He built an undefeated 502-0 record in amateur battles, idolizing Khrome Ryugu to the point of using a Cobalt Drake replica and rejecting all other sponsors. Scouted personally by Khrome to replace Jaxon Cross in Team Pendragon, Ciel was asked to abandon his identity and become the masked Blader Z — a role he accepted out of deep loyalty, even as it stemmed from Khrome's obsession with recreating his lost teammate. His early career highlights include receiving the Obsidian Shell from Khrome, avenging a loss to Takumi Ishiyama, and helping Pendragon in high-stakes pro matches. Later struggles after Khrome's absence led him to train under veterans, obtain Shelter Drake, and ultimately remove his mask to pursue his own Blading path while still respecting his idol. In essence, Ciel is prodigious amateur who sacrificed his name and identity for loyalty, only to grow through pressure, defeat, and self-reflection into a more independent competitor. He embodies themes of idolization, identity loss, and personal growth in the competitive Blading world. ===''Beyblade X''=== ===Manga=== An exceptional Amateur Blader with an undefeated 502 match win streak. parts.title: Custom Line
parts.text:
[[File:Custom Line Logo.png|thumb]]
[[File:Custom Line Expand Blade Logo.png|thumb|Custom Line Expand Blade (Takara Tomy Logo)]]
The {{Translation|'''Custom Line'''|カスタムライン|Kasutamu Rain}} is the third Beyblade system of the [[X Series]] as part of the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline. This line features a magenta band on the packaging for its products.

For a list of parts in the '''Custom Line''' system, see [[List of Custom Line parts]].

==Structure==
{{QuotePart
|quote = CX tops have a blade which separates into 3 parts for enhanced top-building options and fine-tuned performance to suit your style!
|speaker = Official Hasbro Description}}
Unlike the previous [[Basic Line]] and [[Unique Line]] Beyblades, Custom Line Beyblade consists of five main components: the Lock Chip, the Main Blade, the Assist Blade, the Ratchet, and the Bit. The main feature of Custom Line Beyblades is that the Blade can be separated into three components: the Lock Chip, the Main Blade and the Assist Blade. In addition, these three components can be swapped and combined with other parts, allowing for more customization, hence the name of the system.

In February 2026, the '''Expand Blade''' was introduced to extend the characteristics of the CX Line, separating the Blade into four components: the Lock Chip, the Metal Blade, the Over Blade and the Assist Blade and allowing for a higher degree of customization.

===Blade===
'''Blades''' are the top component of the Bey, and act as the main contact points. The center features the Lock Chip, showcasing a sticker of the Bey's Avatar, with a symbol indicating the spin direction. The contact points are made from zinc alloy, while sections of the blade are made of PMMA.

Blades require three Launcher hooks for insertion, enabling the Bey to launch in either of the two required spin directions, whether clockwise or counterclockwise, depending on the Bey.  Compared to Basic and Unique Line Blades, the first year of Custom Line Blades were comprised of three parts: the {{Translation|'''Lock Chip'''|ロックチップ|Rokku Chippu}}, the {{Translation|'''Main Blade'''|メインブレード|Mein Burēdo}}, known as the '''Primary Blade''' in western countries, and the {{Translation|'''Assist Blade'''|アシストブレード|Ashisuto Burēdo}}, known as the '''Auxiliary Blade''' in western countries. 

Custom Line Expand Blades, which debuted a year after the Custom Line's launch, replace the Main Blade with the {{Translation|'''Over Blade'''|オーバーブレード|Ōbā Burēdo}} and the {{Translation|'''Metal Blade'''|メタルブレード|Metaru Burēdo}}.

====Lock Chip====
[[File:LockChipDran.png|thumb|75px|Dran Lock Chip]]
Lock Chips are the top components of the Blade, locking the Main Blade and Assist Blade together. This can be done by using the Bit or a special tool to twist on the Lock Chip to lock it in place. The center features a "Gear Chip", showcasing a sticker of the Bey's Avatar, with a symbol indicating the spin direction. 

[[File:LockChipValkyrie.png|thumb|75px|Valkryie Metal Lock Chip]]
'''Metal Lock Chips''' have metal intergrated into the Lock Chip to add weight and making them slightly taller than a regular Lock Chip. They also feature a hole in the center of the Lock Chip to avoid interfering with the launcher protrusions.

====Main Blade====
[[File:MainBladeBrave.png|thumb|75px|Brave Main Blade]]
Main Blades are the middle components of the Blade, and act as the main contact points. The contact points are made from zinc alloy, while sections of the blade are made of PMMA. Decals are also printed onto the PMMA part of the Main Blade.

There are also Hasbro Debut Main Blades that use the same metal components, but with differently designed plastic component and decals.

====Over Blade====
[[File:OverBladeBreak.png|thumb|75px|Break Over Blade]]
Over blades are the top components of the CX Expand Blade, and act as the main contact points. The contact points are made of PMMA and like its namesake, is placed over the Metal Blade and Assist Blade. Decals are also printed onto the Over Blade.

====Metal Blade====
[[File:MetalBladeBlitz.png|thumb|75px|Blitz Metal Blade]]
Metal Blade are the middle components of the CX Expand Blade, placed under the Over Blade, and act as the main contact points. The contact points are made from zinc alloy. Decals are also printed onto the Metal Blade.

====Assist Blade====
[[File:AssistBladeSlash.png|thumb|75px|Slash Assist Blade]]
Assist Blades are the bottom components of the Blade, and acts as the secondary contact points. They vary in height and contact point design. The contact points are made of PMMA and like its namesake, assists in enhancing the performance of the Main Blade, or Over Blade and Metal Blade.

===Ratchet===
[[File:Ratchet6-60.png|thumb|75px|6-60 Ratchet]]
'''Ratchets''' are the middle components of the Bey, attaching beneath the Blade. They vary in height and contact point design. A Ratchet attaches to the Blade by twisting, which determines the amount of Burst Resistance in each Bey. Spin direction can be changed by manually twisting the outer portion of the Ratchet, indicated by "'''L'''" or "'''R'''" spots on the Ratchet as a guide for proper assembly. 

'''Simple Type Ratchets''' (Hasbro: "RBT-Ratchet") use "O-type joint", that snaps onto the Blade, rather than the standard Ratchet joints that rotate to click into place. 

===Bit===
[[File:BitVortex.png|thumb|50px|Vortex Bit]]
'''Bits''' act as the main contact points with the stadium floor. Most Bits have the standard 12 tooth gear that interact with the gears on the "X-Celerator Rail" ("Xtreme Line") of the [[Xtreme Stadium]], increasing the Bey's speed. Some Bits have alternate number of tooth gears that changes the speed and frequencies of Xtreme Dashes.

These are the additional subtype series of Bits aside from the standard:
*'''Low Bits,''' which are 1mm shorter
*'''High Bits,''' which are 1mm taller
*'''Gear Bits,''' which have extended teeth to catch onto the X-Celerator Rail easier
*'''Disk Bits,''' which have a out

It was released in Japan with the [[Double Xtreme Stadium Set]] on October 12th, 2024 for 8200円. It was later released individually by [[Hasbro]] in western countries as the '''Double Xtreme Motorized Beystadium''' for USD$89.99. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = A new stadium where you can experience two Xtreme Dashes by electronically raising and lowering the center area. |speaker = Official Description}} The '''Double Xtreme Stadium''' is the third stadium released by [[Takara Tomy]] for the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline, following the standard [[Xtreme Stadium]] and the [[Wide Xtreme Stadium]]. Like the standard Xtreme Stadium, the '''Double Xtreme Stadium''' features a square design and "Xtreme Lines", gears that interact with the gears on a Beyblade's [[Bit]] to activate the [[Xtreme Dash]] gimmick. There are 2 sets of "Xtreme Lines" - when the center area is raised, the performance is similar to that of a standard Xtreme Stadium. However, when the center area is lowered, a divot is created and the secondary Xtreme Line can be accessed. There are three stadium exits on one side. The two corner exits are called "Over Zones" and a 2 point "Over Finish" occurs when a Beyblade is knocked into these zones. The wider, central exit is called the "Xtreme Zone" and a 3 point "Xtreme Finish" occurs when a Beyblade is knocked into it. The '''Double Xtreme Stadium''' has appeared in a few [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) tournaments worldwide, although the previously released [[Xtreme Stadium]] remained the tournament standard stadium during this period. ==Dimensions== '''Total Length:''' '''Total Width:''' '''Battle Zone Diameter:''' '''Tornado Ridge Diameter:''' '''Over Zone Length:''' '''Xtreme Zone Length:''' ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-37 [[Double Xtreme Stadium Set]] (black, blue Xtreme Line) ===Hasbro=== * G1864 Double Xtreme Motorized Beystadium ==Gallery== Double Xtreme Stadium.jpeg ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Beyblade X Products (Hasbro)}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

CAD$69.99 |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseUS=May 2025 |ReleaseCA=May 2025 |ReleaseAU=May 2025 |XMasters=❌ |XStandard=❌ |XOpen=✔️ }}The '''Drop Attack Beystadium''' is a stadium released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline. It is included with the [[Drop Attack Battle Set]]. ==Description== {{QuotePart |quote = With the Drop Attack Beystadium, you can descend onto your rival's top: the X-Celerator Rail can send Beyblade tops to a higher level from which they can drop onto opponent's tops! |speaker = Official Description}} The '''Drop Attack Beystadium''' is the fourth [[Hasbro]]-exclusive stadium in the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline. It is modeled after the ''Flying Stadium'' (Japanese: ''Aero Stadium'') that appears in the ''Beyblade X'' anime. The '''Drop Attack Beystadium''' features a rectangular design and an "X-Celerator Rail", a set of gears that interact with the gears on a Beyblade's [[Bit]] to activate the [[Xtreme Dash]] gimmick. Unlike previous rails, the '''Drop Attack Beystadium''' are elevated and travel upwards, allowing Beyblades to drop down into the main Battle Zone. Like Hasbro's previously released "bucket" [[Beystadium (2024)|Beystadium]], the gears of the X-Celerator Rails are molded in, extending to the stadium floor. The '''Drop Attack Beystadium''' has four corner pockets called "Knockout Zones" and a 2 point "Knockout Finish" occurs when a Beyblade is knocked into these zones. The center pocket is called the "Xtreme Finish Zone" and a 3 point "Xtreme Finish" occurs when a Beyblade is knocked into it. ==Dimensions== ==Gallery== Aero Stadium.jpg|Aero Stadium in the anime Aero Stadium Rails.jpg|Rails ==Trivia== *In the anime, the Aero Stadium was developed by the [[Shadow Pros]] and completed by [[Packun]], who describes it as the successor to the [[Double Xtreme Stadium]]. **In the anime, an Xtreme Dash performed in this stadium is called an '''Air Ride Xtreme Dash'''. ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Hasbro Exclusives]]

He fights with his Beyblade, [[ClockMirage 9-65B|Mirage Clock 9-65B]]. ==Appearance== Eight is an average-sized boy with orange eyes and blue hair with black highlights. He also has a large X-shaped scar across his face. His attire includes a grey shirt with blue flames, a black and white checkered scarf, matching wristbands, black pants with white square patterns, black and white checkered socks, and pale blue shoes with grey soles and orange laces. ==Personality== Similar to some of his siblings, Eight is arrogant and smug thanks to his extraordinary blading skills, which he often looks down on other bladers. Similar to [[Three Cross|Three]] and [[Four Cross|Four]], he still relies on the same strategy in battles, which would prove to be a mistake during his rematch against [[Yoko Kyubi|Yoko]], where she's aware about Mirage Clock's weaknesses and is able to stop his Vanishing Time. Like his other siblings, Eight is also desperately trying to win his father's approval, fearing Zero might abandon him if he loses. ==Biography== ===Background=== Eight is one of the nine children of [[Zero Cross]] of the Cross Clan, having eight other siblings who are all talented in blading. But amongst the clan there's an open secret amongst the family of a 10th secret child whose identity is unknown. He would later be witness to his father's plan to destroy and save Xenon City's blading profession from destruction. ===''Beyblade X''=== ==Beyblades== ===Primary Beys=== *'''[[ClockMirage 9-65B|Mirage Clock 9-65B]]''': Eight's Unique Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X''. ===Generic/Replica Beys=== *'''[[List of Generic Beyblades in Beyblade X|Arrow Wizard 4-80B]]''': Eight's Basic Line Beyblade prior to obtaining Mirage Clock. *'''[[OrochiCluster 6-60LF|Coil Orochi 6-60LF]]''': A Unique Line Beyblade that was created by [[Zero Cross]] and completed by [[Five Cross]] to stop [[Jaxon Cross]] from battling [[Khrome Ryugu]]. ===Special Moves=== * {{Special Move|Hyper Boost Vanishing Time}} * {{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} ** Coil Orochi's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Yamata no Orochi". }}The {{Translation|'''Entry Launcher'''|エントリーランチャー|Entorī Ranchā}} is a [[Ripcord Launcher|ripcord launcher]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline. It debuted in Japan on December 2nd, 2023 with the BX-22 [[DranSword 3-60F Entry Package]]. It was later released by [[Hasbro]] in western countries with Starter Packs in their ''Beyblade X'' toyline. Hasbro refers to it as the '''Basic Launcher'''.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote=A tool for spinning a Beyblade. The Entry Launcher is not compatible with the [[Beybattle Pass]] or [[Launcher Grip (Beyblade X)|Launcher Grip]].
|speaker=Official Description}}
The '''Entry Launcher''' is a right-spin [[Ripcord Launcher|ripcord launcher]] released in the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline. It uses a short "''Entry Winder''" (ripcord) that is inserted into the launcher and then pulled out. The ''Entry Winder'' is the shortest winder in ''Beyblade X''. Compared to the [[Winder Launcher]], it is smaller overall, has a shorter winder, and cannot be used with accessories such as Launcher Grips and the [[Beybattle Pass]]. The internal mechanism is also simpler, with its prongs directly attached to the gear spun by the winder. As a result, the prongs free spin more easily, creating a stronger launch. Some copies of the '''Entry Launcher''' have the mechanisms that are pinned too tightly, resulting in prongs that barely spin. Due to its small size and incompatibility with Launcher Grips, the '''Entry Launcher''' is best suited for younger Bladers with smaller hands.

Takara Tomy released the Entry Launcher as a bonus with the [[DranSword 3-60F Entry Package]], and Hasbro includes it with Starter Packs and sets as the '''Basic Launcher'''.

===Mold Variations===
At the time of writing there are two mold variations of the '''Entry Launcher''':

*The original mold released with the Takara Tomy [[DranSword 3-60F Entry Package]]. This mold was later released by Hasbro with Starter Packs and sets.
*The second mold released with the brand collab "Multipack Sets" (Japanese: "Double Starters"). The ''Beyblade X'' logo and winder insertion indicator have been moved further up to create room for brand logos.

===Rulings===
The '''Entry Launcher''' may be used with its included ''Entry Winder'', the regular ''Winder'', the ''Dragon Winder'', and the ''Long Winder''. This ruling is applicable to both official [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) and [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) tournaments.

parts.title: Expand Blade
parts.text:
[[File:Expand Blade Logo.png|thumb|100px|Expand Blade icon (Takara Tomy)]][[File:UX Infinity Logo.png|thumb|100px|UX Infinity icon (Hasbro)]]
The {{Translation|'''Expand Blade'''|エクスパンドブレード|Ekusupando Burēdo}} refers to a group of ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline sub-systems that introduce blades with "expanded" features from the 3 ''Beyblade X'' systems. For example, a Custom Line (CX) '''Expand Blade''' takes the high-customization concept of the Custom Line, and splits the Main Blade into the Metal Blade and Over Blade, increasing the concept further.

[[Hasbro]] released the toyline with the '''Infinity''' suffix added to each line's name. Hasbro products also use a new logo based on the infinity symbol to reflect this name change.

==Structure==
{{QuotePart
|quote = Introducing "Expand Blade", which expands the features of each line: Custom Line, Unique Line, and Basic Line!
|speaker = Official Takara Tomy Description}}
As its name suggests, '''Expand Blade''' primarily refers to BX, UX, and CX Blades with new "expanded" features. For BX Expand Blades, which have metal Launcher Hooks, this expanded feature is even more metal in the center of the Blade. For UX Expand Blades, the Ratchets have been integrated into the Blade, allowing for even more unique gimmicks to be possible. For CX Expand Blades, the Main Blade is split into the Metal Blade and Over Blade, increasing the possibilities of customization.

She fights with her Beyblade, [[SolEclipse D5-70TK|Umbra Sol D 5-70TK]], which is shared with her twin brother, [[Three Cross]]. ==Appearance== Four is a tall, pale-skinned girl with heterochromia eyes, her left eye purple and her right eye orange, and she has purple wavy hair with orange streaks. She also has two moles above and below her right eye. Like her twin brother, she wears a blue jacket with white collar, a black undershirt and a pair of white shorts, but with purple linings, a pair of thigh-high stockings with two light blue stripes, a moon necklace and a pair of dark grey shoes with purple laces. She also occasionally wears a purple long-sheeved jacket with the [[Cross Corporation]] logo. She often carries a small pouch with Three that holds their Beyblade, Umbra Sol. ==Personality== Similar to her twin brother, she is arrogant due to her talent in blading. Like her twin brother, she often mocks bladers she believes to be weaker than her, this also extends to her other siblings, specifically Nine and Six. And due to her talent, she rarely changes her tactics and uses the same strategy during battles, which would be exploited by Sigrid during their rematch. Like Three, she does not take kindly to people saying that she is only strong because of her twin brother. Like her other siblings, Four is also desperately trying to win her father's approval, fearing Zero might abandon her if she loses. ==Biography== ===Background=== Four is one of the nine children of [[Zero Cross]] of the Cross Clan and is also the twin sister of [[Three Cross]], having seven other siblings who are all talented in blading. But amongst the clan there's an open secret amongst the family of a 10th secret child whose identity is unknown. She would later be witness to her father's plan to destroy and save [[Xenon City]]'s blading profession from destruction. ===''Beyblade X''=== ==Beyblades== ===Primary Beys=== *'''[[SolEclipse D5-70TK|Umbra Sol D 5-70TK]]''': Four's Custom Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X'', which she shares with Three, exclusively using its Double Smash Mode. She and Three would later each use use identical copies of Umbra Sol. ===Generic/Replica Beys=== *'''[[TyrannoBeat 3-60T|Beat Tyranno 3-60T]]''': Three's Basic Line Beyblade prior to obtaining Umbra Sol. *'''[[OrochiCluster 6-60LF|Coil Orochi 6-60LF]]''': A Unique Line Beyblade that was created by [[Zero Cross]] and completed by [[Five Cross]] to stop [[Jaxon Cross]] from battling [[Khrome Ryugu]]. ===Special Moves=== * {{Special Move|Hyper Boost Solar Void}} * {{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} ** Coil Orochi's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Yamata no Orochi". After destabilizing the opponent rapid "poisonous" strikes, it lands the final strike by combing two of its snake-headed blades. This Special Move in tadem with Three's Xtreme Dash Yamata no Orochi, both Coil Orochi ram into the opposing Beyblade with combined force and power. ==Beybattles== ===Anime=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 3) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Karla Konjiki]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 101|101]] |Win |- |[[Ginro]] (with [[Three Cross]]) |[[Beyblade X - Episode 104|104]] |Win (4-2) |- |[[Jaxon Cross]] (with Three Cross) |[[Beyblade X - Episode 106|106]] |Lose |- |[[Sigrid Nana-iro]] (with Three Cross) |[[Beyblade X - Episode 111|111]] |Lose |- |[[Nine Cross]] (with Three Cross) |[[Beyblade X - Episode 120|120]] |Win (3-0) |- |[[Million Mizu]] (with Three Cross) |120-[[Beyblade X - Episode 121|121]] |Lose |- |[[Six Cross]] (with Three Cross) |[[Beyblade X - Episode 129|129]] |Lose |} ===Manga=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Ginro]] (with Three Cross) |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 29|29]] |Win |- |[[Jaxon Cross]] (with Three Cross) |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 30|30]] |Lose (0-3) |} ==Official Descriptions== The fourth sibling of the Kurosu Clan and the younger twin sister of Three Kurosu. Like Three, she shows ruthless and merciless tactics toward her opponents. When facing the Shadow Pro Ginro, she demonstrated flawless coordination with Three. Whether it is one on one or two against one makes no difference. Their strength comes from their willingness to use any means necessary. ==Anime Appearances== ===[[Beyblade X (Season 3)]]=== * [[Beyblade X - Episode 101|''Episode 101 - Annihilation'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 103|''Episode 103 - Bey of the Future'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 104|''Episode 104 - The Wolf and the Sun'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 105|''Episode 105 - A Challenge from the Future'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 106|''Episode 106 - As the Super Summit'']

He fights with his ''Wolf'' Beyblades. ==Appearance== ==Personality== ==Biography== ===Background=== Ginro used to teach beyblading to a young Jaxon Cross, until one day when he was at the age of 7. With nothing left to teach him, he gave him a parting gift. Gifting him the strongest bey, "[[DranSword 3-60F|Blue Sword Dran]]". Having one last battle with Jaxon, he was defeated with an [[Xtreme Dash]]. Impressed with Jaxon's power, he soon became concerned with Jaxon's worried expression due to Sword Dran having a chip in the coating of its paint, asking if it could be fixed. Impressed that he was able to chip off a piece of the paint in the metal coating. Questioning on the kind of power to cause a collision. Ginro would tell Jaxon's that Sword Dran's metal coat didn't need fixing. As it's a sign of proof of the power his launch. As the stronger he becomes, the more the metal coat will wear down as he becomes stronger. Leaving him with the final words that with Sword Dran, he will surpass the strongest.''[[Beyblade X]]'' Special Manga, [[Beyblade X - Bonus Chapter 02|''Episode X'']] ===''Beyblade X''=== In the anime, he would also become a teacher to [[Ciel Kaminari]], who wishes to improve following their battle at "The Peak" of [[The X]], and later would become the master of [[Sigrid Nana-iro]], who wishes to become stronger following the defeat against [[Zodiac]]. ==Beyblades== ===Primary Beys=== *'''[[SilverWolf 3-80FB|Sterling Wolf 3-80FB]]''': Ginro's Unique Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X''. In the manga, it would be damaged during a battle with a Shadow Pro, where it fell into a pool of molten metal, while in the anime, a Shadow Pro would throw it in, completely destroying it. *'''[[WolfHunt F0-60DB|Hunt Wolf F 0-60DB]]''': Ginro's Custom Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X''. ===Generic/Borrowed Beys=== *'''Unnamed Generic Beyblade''': A Beyblade used by Ginro before Sterling Wolf in the ''Beyblade X'' manga. *'''[[SharkEdge 3-60LF|Keel Shark 3-60LF]]''': A Beyblade used by Ginro before Sterling Wolf in the ''Beyblade X'' anime. ===Decks=== ====[[Beyblade X: EvoBattle]]==== *Sterling Wolf 3-80FB *Sword Dran 3-60F *Obsidian Shell 4-60D ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|Hyper Boost Volgdrive}} *{{Special Move|Hyper Boost Volg Rampage}} ==Beybattles== ===Anime=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! He fights day and night against the underground professionals known as "underworld pros." Ginro says that the underground professionals are plotting to take over the world, but it is unclear how much of this is true. He proposes that Jaxon teams up with him to fight against the underground professionals, but ends up taking on a certain boy as his apprentice. === [[Beyblade X (Season 3)]] === He always tells a ridiculous story that is hard to tell whether it is true or not, that he has thrown himself into the underworld and is fighting every day to fight against the "underworld professionals" who are plotting to take over the world. He was forced to become a disciple of Shiguru Nanairo and Ciel Kaminari , and eventually became their master. He tries to teach them what the "Bey Spirit" is, but they don't really understand. ==Anime Appearance

parts.title: Hall of Fame (Beyblade X)
parts.text:
{{About|the [[B4]] ban list|WBO X Format Ban List|the [[WBO]] ban list}}
The {{Translation|'''Hall of Fame'''|殿堂入り|Dentōiri}} is a special ban list introduced by [[Takara Tomy]] during ''[[Beyblade X]]''. The list affects parts used in official [[B4]] tournaments (GP, G1, G2, G3). {{Translation|"Hall of Fame parts"|殿堂入りパーツ|Dentōiri Pātsu}} cannot be used in [[1on1 Battle]] and [[3-Blader Battle]] matches, which only use 1 Bey. However, the parts can still be used in [[3on3 Battle]] and [[Team Battle]] matches, which use 3 Beys.<ref>[https://beyblade.takaratomy.co.jp/beyblade-x/_image/regulation.pdf Beyblade X Regulations]</ref>

Changes to the list are scheduled approximately every six months.

There has been one addition to the Hall of Fame list:
*On '''February 15th, 2025''', it was announced that the [[Blade - WizardRod|WizardRod (Wand Wizard) Blade]] would be added to the '''Hall of Fame''' on April 1st, 2025. The '''Hall of Fame''' took into effect on the same day, with the 7th Edition of the B4's Beyblade X Regulations.<ref>[https://twitter.com/tbh_pr/status/1890607541220250013 Twitter post from Beyblade X development team about WizardRod addition]</ref>
**On '''August 28th, 2025''', it was announced that WizardRod would be removed from the '''Hall of Fame''' on November 1st, 2025, after being on the list for 7 months. In addition, products containing WizardRod would be released after its removal.<ref>[https://twitter.com/tbh_pr/status/1960901806432903537 Twitter post from Beyblade X development team about WizardRod removal]</ref>
__NOTOC__
