parts.title: Hold Launcher
parts.text:
{{Product Infobox |Image=Beyblade X Hold Launcher.png |AKA=Victory Grip Launcher (Hasbro) |ProductCode=UX-09 (Takara Tomy)
G1862 (Hasbro) |ProductType=Launcher |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Price=3300円 |System=Unique Line |Series=Beyblade X |ReleaseJP=November 2nd, 2024 |ReleaseUS=July 2025 |ReleaseCA=August 2025 |ReleaseEU=June 2025 }}The '''Hold Launcher''' is a Launcher released as part of the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' series. It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-09 Starter, [[SamuraiSaber 2-70L]], on November 2nd, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as the '''Victory Grip Launcher''' with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Victory Grip Launcher Set]]. ==Description== The '''Victory Grip Launcher''' (Japanese: '''Hold Launcher''') is a right-spin [[Ripcord Launcher]] released for the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline. The '''Hold Launcher''' uses a winder (ripcord) that is inserted into the launcher and then pulled out. The '''Hold Launcher''' includes a longer "''Long Winder''" (90 teeth compared to the standard winder's 81 and the Dragon Winder's 86). Compared to the [[Entry Launcher (Beyblade X)|Entry Launcher]] and [[Winder Launcher]], the '''Hold Launcher''' has a grip integrated into the design and is only compatible with the [[Beybattle Pass]]. The original UX-09/G1862 release includes rubber components which were later re-released with the [[Rubber Custom Grip]]. The BX-00 release does not come with the rubber components, but does include 1 textured plastic component that is not available elsewhere at the time of writing. The '''Hold Launcher''' is also compatible with the plastic components of the [[Custom Grip (Beyblade X)|Custom Grip]]. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * BX-00 [[XenoXcalibur 3-60GF]] * UX-09 [[SamuraiSaber 2-70L]] ===Hasbro=== * G1862 [[Victory Grip Launcher Set]] ==Gallery== ===Takara Tomy=== Beyblade X Hold Launcher.png|Hold Launcher (UX-09) Beyblade X Hold Launcher (BX-00; XenoXcalibur).jpeg|Hold Launcher (BX-00) ===Hasbro=== Beyblade X Victory Grip Launcher.jpeg|Victory Grip Launcher (G1862) ==Trivia== *The Hasbro release replaces the "Hold Launcher" text on the launcher with "Victory Grip Launcher", aligning with the localization. ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Accessories]] [[Category:Launchers]] [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

}}The {{Translation|'''Infinity Stadium'''|インフィニティスタジアム|Infiniti Sutajiamu}} is a Stadium released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline. It was released in Japan with the [[Battle Entry Set Infinity]] on October 11th, 2025 for 7500円.

==Description==
{{QuotePart
|quote=Exciting battles are possible with consecutive Xtreme Dashes, called the Infinity Dash, and intense clashes between Xtreme Dashes!
|speaker=Official Description}}
The '''Infinity Stadium''' is the fourth stadium released by [[Takara Tomy]] for the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' toyline. Like all ''Beyblade X'' stadiums, the '''Infinity Stadium''' has "Xtreme Lines", gears that interact with the gears on a Beyblade's [[Bit]] to activate the [[Xtreme Dash]] gimmick. The '''Infinity Stadium''' is the second largest ''Beyblade X'' stadium, with a long rectangular design similar to the [[Wide Xtreme Stadium]].

The unique feature of the '''Infinity Stadium''' is its symmetrical design, allowing a Beyblade to use consecutive Xtreme Dashes on one side of the stadium, creating the titular "Infinity Dash". The '''Infinity Stadium''' has four corner pockets called "Over Zones" and a 2 point "Over Finish" occurs when a Beyblade is knocked into these zones. The two center pockets are called the "Xtreme Zones" and a 3 point "Xtreme Finish" occurs when a Beyblade is knocked into these zones. The result is faster battles, with Beys exhausting their Stamina more quickly, and Over/Xtreme Finishes becoming more easily scored. In addition, it is easier for Bladers to self-KO due to the smaller space and additional Xtreme Dashes.

Beginning with its release in October 2025, [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) tournaments used the '''Infinity Stadium''' as the new tournament standard stadium, replacing the [[Xtreme Stadium]]. The '''Infinity Stadium''' was used for higher tournament grades in multiple countries, including Grand Prix (GP) tournaments. This lasted until March 2026, when tournament organizers were given the option to use either the Infinity Stadium or the Xtreme Stadium, sometimes using both for different stages of the tournament. Some organizers, such as Toys "R" Us Japan locations, began phasing out the usage of the Infinity Stadium by September 2026, fully transitioning back to the Xtreme Stadium.

Lauren Landa (young) |AppearAnime = [[Beyblade X - Episode 01|X]] |AppearManga = [[Beyblade X - Special Chapter 01]] }}'''Jaxon Cross''', known as {{Translation|'''Ekusu Kurosu'''|{{Ruby|黒須|くろす}}エクス |Kurosu Ekusu}} in Japan, is a member of [[Persona]], the protagonist team of the ''[[Beyblade X]]'' anime and manga.https://twitter.com/beyblade_info/status/1699588298778276180 Jaxon adopts the '''Blader X''' alias, or {{Translation|'''Kamen X'''|仮面 {{Ruby|X|エックス}}|Kamen Ekkusu|Mask X}} in Japan, to hide his identity after leaving his previous team, [[Pendragon]]. He fights with his ''Dran'' Beyblades. ==Appearance== Jaxon is an average-sized boy with blue gear-shaped eyes, blue hair with blonde highlights. A few bangs of his hair are shaped like an "X". When he was 7 years old, Jaxon wore a black shirt and gray shorts, and light gray boots with gray soles. Back when he was in [[Pendragon]], Jaxon wore a black shirt with a necklace and gray shorts. Under his shorts, he wears brown leggings and light gray boots with gray soles. His Blader X attire consisted of a blue mask with a black lens with a gear shaped patter on the lens, and a Red "X" at the center of the lens. He wears a long white short sleeve trench coat with a hoodie and blue lapel flaps, a black short sleeve turtleneck, blue shorts, under his shorts he wears brown leggings and light gray sneakers with blue laces with gray soles. In the manga, [[Persona]]'s logo is printed on his turtleneck. He also wears a pair of wristbands with a large "X" on each of them. His mask also has a large "X" on the back of the mask. ==Personality== Jaxon often enjoys beybattles and has fun when he battles. Unlike several Pro Bladers who view Blading to be nothing more than work, Jaxon does not share that same sentiment at all. Instead, he views blading and every beybattle to be fun. He sometimes acts silly and a little bit lazy. Jaxon also enjoys eating sushi, especially any original sushis from [[Komaba Sushi]] that [[Taisho Sushiya|Taisho]] comes up with. His favorite sushi is the Red Bean and Cream sushi. ==Biography== ===Background=== Jaxon originally grew up in a orphange, having [[Ginro]] be the only family he has, since he did not know who his parents were.''[[Beyblade X]]'', [[Beyblade X - Chapter 28|Chapter 28]] Jaxon used to be taught Blading by his master Ginro, until one day at the age of 7, there was nothing left for Ginro to teach him. As a parting gift, Ginro gave Jaxon the strongest Bey, "[[DranSword 3-60F|Sword Dran Metal Coat: Blue]]". Having one last battle with Ginro, Jaxon won against Ginro using an [[Xtreme Dash]] which chipped off a piece of the blue paint of the metal coat from Sword Dran. Jaxon, believing he had damaged Sword Dran, asked Ginro if it could be repaired; but Ginro, surprised, would tell him that the paint being chipped off was proof of his launch's power. Jaxon was told that as his launch becomes stronger, more of the metal coating will chip off as proof that of his strength. With his final words that with Sword Dran, he will surpass the strongest. As years had passed the paint gradually wore down overtime.''[[Beyblade X]]'' Special Manga, [[Beyblade X - Bonus Chapter 02|Xtra Episode]] ===''Beyblade X''=== Jaxon was recruited for team [[Pendragon]] meeting [[Khrome Ryugu]] for the first time, engaging into a beybattle with him. He won against Khrome, after their first battle with each other despite defeating him, Jaxon wanted to continue battling with Khrome as it was fun. After Sigrid joined the team, they went on an undefeated winning streak. Nearing the top of the X, Sigrid discusses with Jaxon that Khrome has been becoming stronger, but Jaxon felt that Khrome was already strong, Khrome would enter asking for a favor to borrow Sword Dran, which Jaxon let him. After becoming champions of the X, Jaxon felt that being at the top felt that there were no bladers that he could fight seriously but then realized that there was. She fights with her ''Rhino'' Beyblades. ==Appearance== Jian is a small girl with small black eyes, small gray eyebrows, a huge expression when she smiles, and slate gray hair tied in buns with black bun covers. Her attire consists of a light blue tank top, fur-trimmed grey shorts, a necklace with a black gem, a fur-trimmed blue cape, small light blue socks, and grey and white shoes with purple laces. Although Jian appears to be a small child, she has an unusually powerful launch that causes her Launcher to creak. Her launch is one of the best among Pro Bladers. ==Personality== Jian has a cheerful personality, is very sociable, and often makes friends with her opponents. Her speech and actions are often calm and reserved, and she is carefree during battle. She likes to eat after battles. Jian cheers for her teammates when she's not battling. A common trait of her is whenever she smiles, she makes a big expression. She has a strong, sibling-like relationship with [[Toguro Okunaga]], regularly jumping to sit on his shoulders and feeding him by hand. ==Biography== ===Background=== Jian was originally scouted by [[Titus Manju]] when he was forming the amateur team [[Zooganic]]. === ''Beyblade X'' === ==Beyblades== * '''[[SharkEdge 3-60LF|Keel Shark 3-60LF]]''': Jian's Beyblade prior to joining Zooganic. * '''[[RhinoHorn 3-80S|Horn Rhino 3-80S]]''': Jian's Defense Type Basic Line Beyblade in ''[[Beyblade X]]''. * '''[[RhinoHorn 5-80A|Horn Rhino 5-80A]]''': Jian's Attack Type Horn Rhino Custom in [[Beyblade X (Season 2)|''Beyblade X'']] using the [[Bit - Accel|Accel Bit]] as inspiration from Jaxon's [[DranBuster 1-60A|Buster Dran]]. ** It is added with the suffix "Attack Custom" in Japan. ===Decks=== ====[[Beyblade X: Xone]]==== *Horn Rhino 3-80S *Claw Leon 5-80O *Tail Viper 5-60P ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|Rhino Rush}} *{{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} ** Horn Rhino's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Rhino Stomp". She fights with her Beyblade, [[CrimsonGaruda 4-70TP|Scarlet Garuda 4-70TP]]. ==Appearance== Karla is a small girl with red eyes with diamond-shaped pupils being yellow on the outside and white on the inside, with red, green and blue hair styled in twin drills held up with diamond-shaped hair bobbles. When Karla is in a battle, her twin drills would spread out like bird wings. Her attire consists of a white buttoned shirt with long sleeves and golden lining, a golden diamond-shaped gem and a green skirt with red and blue ruffles styled similarly to a bird's wings and feathers. Under her skirt, she wears grey pants with golden lining and yellow sneakers with black soles. ==Personality== She usually ends her conversations with “I say!”. Whenever she yells at her opponents, accusing them of unfair play (as she accused Tenka of tricking her during their Star Battle), her butler Iwao tries to remind her that she must behave as the heir to Gordias; otherwise he has her servants carry her away. She admires Blaze Fujiwara to the point that she considers him her fiancé. ==Biography== ===Background=== ===''Beyblade X''=== She is the daughter of the family to the giant corporation Gordias Fine Jewellery, which supplies metal materials to [[Yggdrasil Inc.|Yggdrasil Pharmaceuticals]]. ==Beyblades== * '''[[CrimsonGaruda 4-70TP|Scarlet Garuda 4-70TP]]''': Karla's Basic Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X''. ===Decks=== ====[[Beyblade X: EvoBattle]]==== *Scarlet Garuda 4-70TP *Rock Golem 0-80UN *Circle Ghost 1-60GB ===Special Moves=== * {{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} ** In High Mode, Scarlet Garuda's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Crimson Burning". Due to its taller height, it strikes the opponent from above. ** In Low Mode, Scarlet Garuda's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Crimson Manuever". Due to its shorter height, it strikes the opponent from below. *{{Special Move|Xtra Shoot Crimson Maneuver}} ==Beybattles== ===Anime=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 2) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Takumi Ishiyama]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 55|55]] |Unknown Result |- |[[Robin Kazami]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 73|73]]-[[Beyblade X - Episode 74|74]] |Win (2-0) |- |[[Blaze Fujiwara]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 86|86]] |Win (2-0) |- |[[Yoko Kyubi]] |86 |Lose |} {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 3) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Four Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 101|101]] |Lose |- |[[One Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 123|123]] |Lose |} ===Manga=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width:100%" data-collapsetext="Hide" data-expandtext="Show" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;"|Beyblade X |- !Opponent !Chapter !Result |- |[[Robin Kazami]] |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 18|18]] |Win (2-0) |} ==Official Descriptions== She is the heir of the giant corporation Gordias Fine Jewellery and the leader of the team "Gordias". She calls herself the fiance of Blaze Fujiwara. She loves flashy things and is free-spirited, but also calculating, and hopes to one day marry Blaze and merge her company with Yggdrasil Pharmaceuticals to rule the world. Her Beyblade skills are solid, and she considers herself superior to Blaze. She seems to have a connection with Tenka Shiroboshi. ==Anime Appearances== ===[[Beyblade X (Season 2)]]=== *[[Beyblade X - Episode 52|''Episode 52 - Restart'']] (visioned; prologue) *[[Beyblade X - Episode 55|''Episode 55 - Advance Bey Timeshift'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 57|''Episode 57 - Tri-Blader Battle'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 58|''Episode 58 - Triple Battle'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 59|''Episode 59 - Blader S'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 60|''Episode 60 - Multi-Colored Trial'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 70|''Episode 70 - Dread Dragon'']] (image) *[[Beyblade X - Episode 72|''Episode 72 - Labyrinth of Riddles Fear'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 73|''Episode 73 - The Star Battle'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 74|''Episode 74 - Cursed'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 75|''Episode 75 - Return of the Knight'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 76|''Episode 76 - White Nova'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 80|''Episode 80 - The Gradual One'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 85|''Episode 85 - Pop vs. Curse'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 86|''Episode 86 - Red Confrontation'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 88|''Episode 88 - Blading Soul'']] (video) *[[Beyblade X - Episode 89|''Episode 89 - What Must Be Done'']] (flashback) *[[Beyblade X - Episode 90|''Episode 90 - Nine-Tailed Fox'']] (video) *[[Beyblade X - Episode 97|''Episode 97 - Star Battle Grand Final'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 99|''Episode 99 - Supernova'']] *[[Beyblade X - Episode 100|''Episode 100 - Star Devourer'']] ===[[Beyblade X (Season 3)]]=== *[

[[Winder Launcher L]] (With Dragon Winder) |Team = [[Pendragon]] |JpVoice = [[Wikipedia:Kaito Ishikawa|Kaito Ishikawa]] |EnVoice = Stephen Fu |AppearAnime = [[Beyblade X - Episode 01|X]] |AppearManga = [[Beyblade X - Chapter 01|X]] }}'''Khrome Ryugu''', known as {{Translation|'''Kuromu Ryugu'''|{{Ruby|龍宮|りゅうぐう}}クロム|Ryūgū Kuromu|Ryugu Kuromu}} in Japan, is the main antagonist in the first season of the ''[[Beyblade X (Season 1)|Beyblade X]]'' anime/manga series. He fights with his ''Drake'' and ''Dragoon'' Beyblades. Khrome adopts the '''Blader Y''' alias, or {{Translation|'''Kamen Y'''|仮面 {{Ruby|Y|ワイ}}|Kamen Wai|Mask Y}} in Japan, initially in an attempt to better understand [[Jaxon Cross]]. In the manga, this alias is only briefly used for the duration of the chapter. In the second and third seasons of the anime, Khrome retains this alias while fighting as a [[Shadow Pros|Shadow Pro]], he would later return to Pendragon following his battle against Jaxon. ==Appearance== Khrome is a tall male with blonde and bright green hair and turquoise eyes and highlights that resemble dragon claws. He has two long locks of hair where he wears a metal hair ornament that is shaped like a dragon that is a souvenir keychain that was originally meant to attach to a pen.''[[Beyblade X]]'' Episode 20, ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 20|Memories of Sushi]]'' It was given to [[Jaxon Cross]] by the company's president, the former of whom promptly affixed it to Khrome's hair. It was scattered after the match between him and Jaxon during the title match between Pendragon and Persona. Following his recovery, he would recieve a replica from [[Zodiac]]. Khrome wears a turquoise [[wikipedia:Chinese clothing|changshan shirt]], black leather jacket with cuffs on the sleeves, black fingerless gloves with light blue stripe on the cuffs and the borders around the finger sleeves, a red belt tied around his waist, lime green pants with a dark azur design, under his pants he wears black-gray leggings, and black sneakers with light blue soles. After obtaining Impact Drake and MeteorDragoon, his eye's sclera turned black, and his eyes become a light gray, with bright blue hightlights. his voice becomes more agreesive. When he was Blader Y, his attire consisted of a blue mask with a black lens with a gear shaped pattern on the lense, and a lime green "Y" at the center of the lense similar to Jaxon's Blader X mask, outside of the lense his mask has 3 claws with a lime green "Y" on the claws. The mask also has a voice filter. He wears a light blue hoodie with a red stripe, his jacket as a zipper with a "Y" on it, the zipper pocket on his jacket has two blue attachements on the zipper, under his jacket is a black turtleneck, blue jean pants, and black sneakers with gray soles. His also wears a gray, black, and blue backpack with a lime green "Y" on it. ==Personality== Khrome was a calm and respectful Blader, until he met and loss to Jaxon, after which he was obsessed with him. That obsession grew when Jaxon left to reclimb The X and challenge Khrome for the title. During and after the fight at the top of The X, his obsession grew into hatred. After obtaining Impact Drake and MeteorDragoon, he becomes more aggressive. ==Biography== ===Background=== Khrome is a member of the 3-person team [[Pendragon]], the current champion team. He borrowed [[DranSword 3-60F|Sword Dran 3-60F]] from his teammate [[Jaxon Cross]] during his decisive match at the top of [[The X]]. But after becoming champions of [[The X|the X]], Jaxon told Khrome of his descision to leave Pendragon. ===''Beyblade X''=== ==Beyblades== === Primary Beys === *'''[[CobaltDrake 4-60F|Cobalt Drake 4-60F]]''': Khrome's clockwise spinning Basic Line Beyblade in ''[[Beyblade X (Season 1)|Beyblade X]]''. *'''[[CobaltDragoon 2-60C|Cobalt Dragoon 2-60C]]''': Khrome's counter-clockwise spinning Basic Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X''. *'''[[ImpactDrake 9-60LR|Impact Drake 9-60LR]]''': Khrome's clockwise spinning Unique Line Beyblade in ''[[Beyblade X (Season 2)|Beyblade X]]'' which is offered to him by [[Omega Shiroboshi]]. *'''[[ImpactDrake 7-80GP|Impact Drake 7-80GP]]''': Khrome's Balance Type Beyblade Custom in the ''[[Beyblade X (Season 2)|Beyblade X]]'' anime after combining the Impact Drake Blade with the [[Ratchet - 7-80|7-80 Ratchet]] and [[Bit - Gear Point|Gear Point Bit]] from the Balance Custom

She fights with her Beyblades, [[UnicornDelta PO3-60GU|Delta Unicorn PO 3-60GU]] and [[CrocoTread TQ5-50GN|Tread Croc TQ 5-50GN]]. ==Appearance== Kiwami is a tall woman with short brown hair in a style of a pixie cut, with two red streaks forming an "X" . She wears a pair of gem shaped earings with red and black accents. Kiwami wears a shirt collar shirt, with a gray blazer over it with 3/4 length sleeves with cuffs, gray pants, with a brown belt with a gold colored bucke around her waist, and brown shoes. While possing as the Bey Kingdom's Anti-Royalist Faction, she wore a pair of sunglasses. ==Personality== ==Biography == ===Background=== Kiwami is highly skillful in Amateur Blader tournaments, eventually becoming one of the top Amateur Bladers there. She was considered highly promising for the future, but because she prefers watching Pro battles as a fan, she declines many Pro scouts and chooses to remain an Amateur Blader. Instead, she decides to work as a high-ranking civil servant. ===''Beyblade X''=== ==Beyblades== ===Primary Beys=== * '''[[UnicornDelta PO3-60GU|Delta Unicorn PO 3-60GU]]''': Kiwami's Custom Line Expand Blade Balance Type Bey in ''[[Beyblade X (Season 3)|Beyblade X]]'', created by [[Packun]] using [[One Cross]]'s [[BahamutBlitz BK1-50I|Blitz Bahamut]]'s Custom Line Expand Blade concept and [[Yuni Naniwa]]'s [[UnicornSting 5-60GP|Sting Unicorn]] as reference. * '''[[CrocoTread TQ5-50GN|Tread Croc TQ 5-50GN]]''': Kiwami's Custom Line Expand Blade Defense Type Bey in ''[[Beyblade X (Season 4)|Beyblade X]].'' ===Generic/Borrowed Beys=== *'''[[WyvernGale 5-80GB|Gale Wyvern 5-80GB]]''': Kiwami's Basic Line Beyblade prior to obtaining Delta Unicorn. ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} **Delta Unicorn's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Delta Strike". Set in its Attack Style, Delta Unicorn strikes the opponent with its "attack blade" with great force. **Tread Croc's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Doom Death Roll". Using the momentum from the opponent and its tire-like blades, it performs a counter attack on the opponent. ==Beybattles== ===Anime=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 3) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Two Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 127|127]] |Lose (0-1) |} {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 4) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Robin Kazami]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 136|136]] |TBA |} ===Manga=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Packun]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 126|126]] (flashback) |Unknown |- |[[Two Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 34|34]] |Lose (0-1) |- |[[Robin Kazami]] |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 40|40]] |Win (2-0) |- |[[Jaxon Cross]] |40 |Lose (0-2) |} ==Official Descriptions== An elite civil servant. Not a professional blader. She was active as one of the top amateur Bladers and was considered highly promising for the future, but because she is a true Bey fan at heart, she chose to remain an amateur, saying, “I want to support the pros.” Her love for Beys and respect for professional Bladers are stronger than anyone else’s. Her skills have not declined, and she challenges the Cross family to save X City from crisis. ==Anime Appearances== ===[[Beyblade X (Season 3)]]=== * [[Beyblade X - Episode 126|''Episode 126 - The Traitor Who Betrayed'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 127|''Episode 127 - The Kurosu Family's Strategy'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 128|''Episode 128 - Guardian of the X Tower'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 131|''Episode 131 - Betting on the Future'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 132|''Episode 132 - The True Battle at the Top'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 133|''Episode 133 - The Final Future'']] * [[Beyblade X - Episode 134|''Episode 134 - The True Final Future'']] ===[[Beyblade X (Season 4)]]=== * [[Beyblade X - Episode 136|''Episode 136 - The 88th Prince'']] ==Manga Appearances== ===[[Beyblade X]]=== * [[Beyblade X - Chapter 34|''Chapter 34 - The Second Assassin'']] * [[Beyblade X - Chapter 40|''Chapter 40'']] ==Relationships== ===[[Packun]]=== Packun is responsible for creating Delta Unicorn for Kiwami. In return, Packun requests Kiwami to represent him to challenge the Cross family on the Second Stage of the True X War. ===[[Dima Dil Kanz]]=== Dima recruited Kiwami as his private secretary, and is the only person whom he trusts. ==Quotes== *"Brace swiftly through, Delta Unicorn!" ==Videos==

He fights with his Beyblade, [[PerseusDark B6-80W|Dark Perseus B 6-80W]]. ==Appearance== Lantz is a tall male with light blond hair and blue eyes. He sports a pair of glasses with a diamond on the bridge and temples that wrap around his head. His attire consists of a black button-up long sleeved shirt with diamond patterns on the collar and sleeves, a black belt, a pair of light blue trousers and black shoes. On his left hand, he wears a red glove and a snake accessory covered under the sleeve, in reference to Medusa's snake hair. On his right hand, he wears three diamond-shaped rings on his index, middle and ring fingers. In the anime, his battle attire, he also wears a blue dress shirt, a blue tie and a black coat with blue linings. ==Personality== Lantz is shown to be arrogant, overconfident and very prideful of himself. Because of his talent and immense hardworking towards battles he is also very calculative and never loses his composure. But this is also his greatest weakness, as he is shown to lose temper when his predictions towards win misses, like in his battle against Robin where he became frustated. ==Biography== ===Background=== Prior to joining the Shiroboshi School, Lantz was highly talented in sports and academics. He often isolates himself from other kids his age. Due to his arrogrant personality and often deemed others as weaklings, he was picked on by other kids. On a rainy day, he was spotted by Omega and Tenka who were walking by. Omega asked Lantz to join the Shiroboshi School to become an invincible version of himself. ===''Beyblade X''=== Lantz was one of the two disciples who was skilled enough to contend for first and second rank within the Shiroboshi School. Due to Omega's rebelling against the Shiroboshi's rule of participating in the [[The X|X Tower]] and subsequent banishment, he, along with [[Million Mizu|Million]], followed her to form [[Zodiac]].''[[Beyblade X (Season 2)|Beyblade X]]'' Episode 93, [[Beyblade X - Episode 94|''Super Summit Challenger Showdown'']] ==Beyblades== ===Primary Beys=== *'''[[PerseusDark B6-80W|Dark Perseus B 6-80W]]''': Lantz's Custom Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X''. In the manga, it would later be damaged in the final battle against Robin during the Super Summit Title Match. ===Generic/Borrowed Beys=== *'''[[LeonClaw 5-60T|Claw Leon 5-60T]]''': Lantz's Basic Line Beyblade prior to obtaining Dark Perseus. ===Decks=== ====[[Beyblade X: EvoBattle]]==== *Dark Perseus B 6-80W *Flame Cerberus W 3-70A *Aero Pegasus 5-80WB ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} **Dark Perseus's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Righteous Blade". Using its wavy shape, it strikes the opponent, breaking the opponent's stance and resulting in a Burst Finish. *{{Special Move|Air Ride Xtreme Dash}} ==Beybattles== ===Anime=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 2) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Ciel Kaminari]] (Blader Z) |[[Beyblade X - Episode 72|72]] |Win (1-0) |- |[[Robin Kazami]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 92|92]] |Lose (0-1) |- |[[Jaxon Cross]] (Blader X) |92 |Draw (0-0) |- |[[Ryu Isshin]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 93|93]] (flashback) |Win |- |[[Tenka Shiroboshi]] and [[Million Mizu]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 96|96]] (flashback) |Lose |- |Robin Kazami |[[Beyblade X - Episode 98|98]] |Draw (0-0) |} {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 3) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Five Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 120|120]]-[[Beyblade X - Episode 121|121]] |Win (2-0) |} ===Manga=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X |- !Opponent !Chapter !Result |- |[[Robin Kazami]] |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 22|22]] |Lose (0-1; On Purpose) |- |[[Jaxon Cross]] |22 |Draw (Results revealed in [[Beyblade X - Chapter 23|23]]) |- |Robin Kazami |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 26|26]] |Draw |} ==Official Descriptions== He is a former disciple of the Shiroboshi style and one of its strongest students. He left the school following Omega Shiroboshi’s defection. His admiration for Omega is so deep that he would even go against Omega’s own wishes for his sake. Calling himself a dojo breaker, he appears at Komaba Sushi and challenges them to a “Star Battle” with 100 stars on the line. parts.title: Limited Rule
parts.text:
[[File:Tobu Zoo Cup G2 2024 Limited Rule.png|thumb|Limited Parts]]
The {{Translation|'''Limited Rule'''|リミテッドルール|Rimiteddo Rūru}} was a special rule used once by [[B4]] at the open-class "Tobu Zoo Cup" Grade 2 (G2) event, held on June 15th, 2024. The Limited Rule was only used during the qualifying tournament, which was played in the "[[1on1 Battle]]" format.<ref name="Website">[https://beyblade.takaratomy.co.jp/beyblade-x/event/g2_tobuzoocup2024.html Tobu Zoo Cup page]</ref>

==Description==
For each {{Translation|"Limited Part"|リミテッドパーツ|Rimiteddo Pātsu}} used, the opponent will receive 1 point at the beginning of the match, for each Limited Part used. For example, if the popular competitive combo '''Wizard Rod 9-60B''' is used, the opponent will receive 3 points before the match begins, since 3 Limited Parts were used. Matches are played to 4 points.<ref name="Website"/>

==Limited Parts==
*[[Blade - CobaltDrake|CobaltDrake]]
*[[Blade - PhoenixWing|PhoenixWing]]
*[[Blade - WizardRod|WizardRod]]
*[[Ratchet - 9-60|9-60]]
*[[Bit - Ball|Ball]]
*[[Bit - Orb|Orb]]

==Trivia==
*As the "Tobu Zoo Cup" event was highly publicized (including western reporters being invited), it is possible that the Limited Rule was introduced to increase the diversity of parts in the resulting coverage.

==External Links==

[[Wikipedia: Yū Serizawa|Yu Serizawa]] (Female) }}{{Translation|'''Line Shindo'''|{{Ruby|進堂|しんどう}}ライン|Shindō Rain}} is the main protagonist of the ''[[Beyblade X: EvoBattle]]'' video game. They fight with their Beyblade, [[LeonFang T4-60A|Fang Leon T 4-60A]]. ==Appearance== Line has dark brown hair with orange and yellow accents. The male version has short and mostly spiky dark brown hair and the yellow accents represents a claw on the left side of his head. There is also an orange are that extends around his eye but doesn't fully cover it. The female version has the male version's style mirrored where the claw is now on the right side. she also has long orange hair. Both outfits remain the same. The outift is a red jacket with a white stripe and white zip up with a stripe of black at the upper chest. The outfit also contains a maroon belt and black shorts with brown rims (The female uses a short-shorts version with the same color scheme) and black leggings. The shoes are white and orange with thre orange claw-like pieces at the front of each shoe. ==Personality== ==Biography== ===Background=== ==Beyblades== *'''[[LeonFang T4-60A|Fang Leon T 4-60A]]''': Line's Beyblade in ''[[Beyblade X: EvoBattle]]'' video game. *'''[[LeonFang T4-60B|Fang Leon T 4-60B]]''': Line's Stamima Custom Fang Leon in ''EvoBattle''. *'''[[LeonFang T4-60N|Fang Leon T 4-60N]]''': Line's Defense Custom Fang Leon in ''EvoBattle''. *'''[[LeonFang T4-60T|Fang Leon T 4-60T]]''': Line's Balance Custom Fang Leon in ''EvoBattle''. ===Decks=== ====[[Beyblade X: EvoBattle]] (tutorial)==== *Fang Leon T 4-60A *Aero Pegasus 7-60LF *Cobalt Dragoon 9-60E ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} **Fang Leon's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Absolute Fang". With the Turn Assist Blade set in Parry mode, it uses its 4 fang-like blades to strike the opponent with rapid hits, before spinning the opponent around and tossing it. ==Official Descriptions== ===[[Beyblade X: EvoBattle]]=== A graduate of the Bey Academy Blader Course. They are emotional and fearless, and once they decide to do something, they go straight for it without looking back. They are aiming to become a pro in order to make Mice a super famous crafter. ==Gallery== Beyblade X EvoBattle - Line Shindo (Male) 2.png|Male Line Title Screen Render Beyblade X EvoBattle - Line Shindo (Female) 2.png|Female Line Title Screen Render ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{X Characters (Video Game)}} [[Category:Video Game Exclusives]] [[Category:Male characters]] [[Category:Female characters]]

{{Part Infobox |Image=LockChipBahamut.png |Name=Bahamut |JPName=バハムート |RomajiName=Bahamūto |ProductCode=CX-13 |Classification=Lock Chip |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=1.7 grams |System=Custom Line |Series=Beyblade X (Season 3) |ReleaseJP=February 19th, 2026 (Expand Holo Sticker)Released with the ''Beyblade X Certain Victory Xtra Guide 2026''
March 28th, 2026 |ReleaseCA=May 12th, 2026 |ReleaseAU=June 24th, 2026 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Bahamut'''|バハムート|Bahamūto}} is a [[Lock Chip]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Custom Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the CX-13 Starter, [[BahamutBlitz BK1-50I]], on March 28th, 2026. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Infinity Starter Pack, [[Blitz Bahamut BK 1-50I]]. ==Description== The '''Bahamut''' Lock Chip features [[wikipedia:jp:黒竜|Kokuryū]]Takara Tomy product overview video [[wikipedia:Dragon Fire|exhaling fire]]. Like motifs from past generations based on Bahamut, the motif is a dragon, rather than the fish of the same name from Arabic mythology. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * CX-13 [[BahamutBlitz BK1-50I]] * CX-16 [[Start Dash Set C]] - [[BahamutBlitz BK1-50I]] ===Hasbro=== * G4572 [[Blitz Bahamut BK 1-50I]] ==Gallery== LockChipBahamut.png|Bahamut (CX-13/G4572) ExpandHoloSticker.png|Bahamut (Expand Holo Sticker) ==Trivia== *In the Takara Tomy product overview video, the motif was confirmed as Kokuryū (the Black Dragon) from Japanese mythology, rather than the fish that is named [[wikipedia:Bahamut|Bahamut]] in Arabic mythology. **A draconic deity named [[wikipedia:Bahamut (Dungeons & Dragons)|Bahamut]] appears in ''[[wikipedia:Dungeons & Dragons|Dungeons & Dragons]]'', and may also be the inspiration for the dragon motif's name. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Custom Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the CX-11 [[EmperorMight Deck Set]] on November 1st, 2025. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[X-treme Battlers Pack]]. ==Description== The '''Emperor''' Lock Chip features an [[wikipedia:Imperial crown|imperial crown]]. '''Emperor''' is a ''Metal Lock Chip'', composed of a plastic component with a metal component on top. As a result, '''Emperor''' is 3 grams heavier and slightly taller than a regular Lock Chip. Due to the added height, and a lack of an indent for a motif sticker, there is a hole in the center of the Lock Chip to avoid interfering with the launcher protrusions. Compared to the other Metal Lock Chip, [[Lock Chip - Valkyrie|Valkyrie]], '''Emperor''' weighs about 1 gram less. ===Rulings=== Only 1 '''Emperor''' Metal Lock Chip may be used in a deck. This applies to both official [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) tournaments and [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) ranked tournaments. However, both the '''Emperor''' and Valkyrie Metal Lock Chips may be used in a deck. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * CX-11 [[EmperorMight Deck Set]] - [[EmperorMight HOp]] ===Hasbro=== * G3028 [[X-treme Battlers Pack]] - [[Might Emperor H Op]] ==Gallery== LockChipEmperor.png|Emperor (CX-11/G3028) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Custom Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

}}'''Antler''' is a [[Main Blade]] released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the [[Custom Line]] system. It debuted in western countries with the release of the Custom Line Starter Pack, [[Antler Stag B 2-60HN]]. It later debuted in Japan as {{Translation|'''Antlers'''|アントラーズ|Antorāzu}} with the release of the CX-00 B4 Limited Booster, [[BucksAntlers B2-60D]], on July 9th, 2026.

==Description==<!--
{{QuotePart
|quote = 
|speaker = Official Description}}-->
<onlyinclude>'''Antler''' is a circular Stamina Type Main Blade with three smooth contact points. '''Antler''' is a retool of [[Main Blade - Flame|Flame]], with the exact same metal components, but a new plastic component. While the plastic component of Flame had a total of 9 holes, the plastic component of '''Antler''' is completely filled in, with additional plastic covering the top of the metal. As a result, the plastic of '''Antler''' weighs 0.3 grams more than Flame. In addition, '''Antler''' appears to consistently have a heavier metal component than Flame, resulting in a higher weight overall.

'''Antler''' appeared on North American store shelves a month after Flame's release in Japan, in wave 6. It would not be until wave 7 that Hasbro released Flame, making this the third instance where a retool was released by Hasbro before the original part. The first instance was the [[Blade - LeonClaw|LeonClaw]] and [[Blade - Steel Samurai|SamuraiSteel]] Blades, followed by the [[Blade - ShelterDrake|ShelterDrake]] and [[Blade - Gill Shark|SharkGill]] Blades.

===Rulings===
'''Antler''' is treated as a different part from Flame, despite sharing the same metal components. Both '''Antler''' and Flame can be used in the same deck at [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) ranked tournaments.</onlyinclude>

parts.title: Main Blade - Blast
parts.text:
{{Part Infobox |Image=MainBladeBlast.png |Name=Blast |JPName=ブラスト |RomajiName=Burasuto |ProductCode=CX-07 (Takara Tomy)
G2350 (Hasbro) |Classification=Main Blade |Type=Attack |SpinDirection=Right-Spin |Weight=32.8 grams |System=Custom Line |Series=Beyblade X (Season 2) |ReleaseJP=July 19th, 2025 |ReleaseUS=May 15th, 2026 |ReleaseCA=July 15th, 2026 |AttackStat=50 |DefenseStat=10 |StaminaStat=15 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Blast'''|ブラスト|Burasuto}} is a [[Main Blade]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Custom Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the CX-07 Starter, [[PegasusBlast ATr]], on July 19th, 2025. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Clip & Rip Launcher Set]]. ==Description== The '''Blast''' Main Blade has three "wings" acting as the main contact points, similar to the previously released [[Main Blade - Brave|Brave (Courage)]] Main Blade. Compared to Brave, '''Blast''' is heavier and has more rounded contact points. As a result, '''Blast''' has comparable Attack power and greater Stamina compared to Brave. Since its release, '''Blast''' has primarily been paired with the [[Assist Blade - Wheel|Wheel]] Assist Blade, and later [[Assist Blade - Heavy|Heavy]]. It was also heavily paired with the [[Lock Chip - Valkyrie|Valkyrie (Valkerion)]] Metal Lock Chip, and later the [[Lock Chip - Emperor|Emperor]] Metal Lock Chip, which was more accessible. The general Attack performance of '''Blast''' is excellent against Stamina-type opponents, and its heavy weight allows '''Blast''' to excel in matchups against other Attack-type combos. However, the top-heavy nature of [[Custom Line]] combos such as '''Blast''' means a higher likelihood to topple at lower spin velocities. Compared to BX Blades such as [[Blade - PhoenixWing|PhoenixWing (Soar Phoenix)]] and UX Blades such as [[Blade - SharkScale|SharkScale (Scale Shark)]], '''Blast''' combos are more prone to Destabilization. Despite this, '''Blast''' continues to be the most popular Main Blade since its release in Japan, being regularly used in [[Beyblade Battle Base]] (B4) and [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) tournaments. '''Blast''' also made several appearances in the [[Beyblade X World Championship 2025]], used by many participating representatives. However, '''Blast''' did not see a worldwide release from [[Hasbro]] until a year after its release by [[Takara Tomy]]. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *CX-07 [[PegasusBlast ATr]] (Metal Coat: Green) *CX-00 [[PegasusBlast ATr]] (Metal Coat: Red) ===Hasbro=== *G2350 [[Clip & Rip Launcher Set]] - [[Blast Pegasus A Tr]] ==Gallery== MainBladeBlast.png|Blast (CX-07/G2350) Blast (Metal Coat Red).png|Blast (Metal Coat: Red) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Custom Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

True to her name, she wears a maid's outfit consisting of an azure dress with white and dark blue designs and white ruffles, a white ruffled apron with a gray belt and bearing [[Komaba Sushi]]'s logo, tights and brown boots with brown laces and a white headdress. ==Personality== Meiko has a calm and collected demeanor and a mature personality. He fights with his Beyblade, [[CerberusFlame W5-80WB|Flame Cerberus W 5-80WB]]. ==Appearance== Million is a tall muscular male with brown, orange and yellow spiky hair which are tied in three long hair ties, and orange eyes with canine fang on the irises. His attire consists of a sleeveless grey shirt with a collar that is designed similarly to a canine's jaw and covers his mouth, brick-red pants with three white lines on the left leg, black boots with orange laces, grey soles and canine prints, which match the theme of his Beyblade. He wears three golden bracelets on each of his arms and a golden necklace with three rings. ==Personality== ==Biography== ===Background=== Prior to joining the Shiroboshi School, Million had neither experience nor interest in Blading, only first trying it when a few of the Shiroboshi School's disciplines challenge him to a battle and easily defeating them. He was then humbled by Omega, who taunts him for being weak at not cultivating his talent in Blading. This inspried Million's interest to become stronger in Beyblade. ''[[Beyblade X (Season 2)|Beyblade X]]'' Episode 97, ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 97|Star Battle Grand Final]]'' ===''Beyblade X''=== Million was one of the two disciples who was skilled enough to contend for first and second rank within the Shiroboshi School. She fights with her ''Wizard'' and ''Knight'' Beyblades. ==Appearance == Multi is a young girl with black eyes and black hair with rainbow-colored streaks and bangs. In her casual outfit, she wears a gray headband with horns, a black shirt with rainbow stripes and gray shorts. Under her shorts, she wears brown-gray leggings and black sneakers with gray soles. On occasions, she would wear a purple hoodie over her casual clothes and wear a beige hat with horns over her head. One of Multi's main talents is the ability to [[wikipedia:Quick-change (performance)|quick-change]] into different outfits. When using her Wizard Beyblades, she wears an outfit for her "cute self", and when using her Knight Beyblades, she wears an outfit for her "cool self". In her "cute" outfit, Multi wears an [[wikipedia:Japanese idol|idol outfit]], with a pair of headphones, a white top with a black ascot with a yellowish-gray gem, a black corset with a white bow and a black knee length skirt with yellow, green and pink ruffles as well as 3 stripes going on the side, her nails grow a little and are a pale pink color. Under her skirt, she wears sheer tights and black boots with silver buckles. In the manga, during Warden's exam, the gemher was replace with a clock on the black ascot, her headhphones had bunny ears on them, with one ear having the roman numeral '''X''' "10" and '''II''' "2" on the other. And her sheer tights had a stripes on them. During the Star Battle event, Multi's headphones had a star on them and the gem was replaced with a star. In her "cool" outfit, Multi wears a [[wikipedia:Magic (illusion)|magician's outfit]], with a top hat, cape, gloves, and dress shoes. The left side of her blazer has blue and yellow stripes while one side of her right pant leg has blue and pink stripes, the other side yellow and green stripes. She has a blue cloth wrapped around her waist as a belt. In her Bey Crafter attire, Multi wears a red pair of glasses, her attire consists of a blue shirt, a black tie, a [[wikipedia:White coat|lab coat]] over her shirt, a lanyard containing her Bey Crafter's license, and black pants. On occasions she would wear a trencher on her head. In the manga, during the battle with team Zooganic, Multi wore a kimono with short leeves with ruffles, with a headband with fox ears, an obi belt with a rainbow on it and a "M" on the decorative string, a black knee length skirt with ruffles, with a tail behind. Under her skirt, she wears sheer tights and boot with buckles. While working part time at [[Komaba Sushi]], on her hair she has a sushi hair clip, her uniform consists of a red kosode with a rainbow pattern on the collar, an orange obi, a pink hakama, white tabi socks, and zori sandals. During the match with Team Zodiac during the Super Summit Event, Multi would dawn the Blader X attire. Another one of her talents, is imitating others. As she was able to imitate Jaxon's voice and replicate his behavior as she poses as Blader X. During the match with the Kurosu All-Stars, Multi would debut her "strong attire", where she would wear an outfit that is a mix between Jaxon and his Blader X persona where she wears a black shirt with a necklace and gray shorts with brown leggings underneath, like Jaxo

She was introduced in the third season to request help from [[Jaxon Cross]] to defeat her father, [[Zero Cross]], joining [[Persona]], the protagonist team of the series, as the fourth member of the team. She fights with her Beyblade, [[RagnaRage FE4-55Y|Rage Ragna FE 4-55Y]]. Prior to obtaining Rage Ragna, she often fought alongside [[EmperorMight HOp|Might Emperor H Op]] in the anime. ==Appearance== Nine is an average-sized girl with light and dark blue hair mixed in a ponytail and blue eyes, with a yellow headdress shaped like an "X." Her attire consisted of a blue shirt with light purple vertical zigzags with a high collar, a yellow "x" over a blue star on the left side, short sleeves, a gray short-sleeve collared jacket with the [[Cross Corporation]] logo (which she sometimes wears over the shirt), sky blue wristbands with a yellow stripe, lavender fingerless gloves, a white skort, gray socks, and white sneakers with blue highlights and black shoelaces and soles. Sometimes, she carries a jetpack, which she uses to fly around with. When she was a small child, she had twin short ponytails. She wore a light sky blue shirt with a cyan jacket with the Cross Corporation logo over it, white shorts with a blue stripe. and grey socks and blue sneakers with white highlights and shoelaces and black soles. ==Personality== ==Biography== ===Background=== Nine is one of the nine children of [[Zero Cross]] of the Cross family, having eight other siblings who are all talented in blading, she was deemed the weakest amongst her siblings. But amongst the clan there's an open secret amongst the family of a 10th secret child whose identity is unknown. She would later be witness to her father's plan to destroy and save [[Xenon City]]'s blading profession from annihilation. ===''Beyblade X''=== After watching Jaxon's battle during the Star Battle Grand Final, she was certain that Jaxon was her brother due to how strong of a Blader he is. After Persona has cleared through all stages at the clash of the True X, Nine is revealed to be the third member of team Kurosu All-Stars. Zero even stating that Nine is actually the strongest sibling after One, with her true abilities hidden from the rest of her siblings. Nine was always going to betray team Persona under Zero's orders to reach his perfect future for Beyblade. ==Beyblades== ===Primary Beys=== *'''[[EmperorMight HOp|Might Emperor H Op]]''': A Custom Line Beyblade made by Multi with Nine's suggestion, mainly used by Nine as a part of [[Persona]] in the ''Beyblade X'' anime. *'''[[RagnaRage FE4-55Y|Rage Ragna FE 4-55Y]]''': Nine's Custom Line Expand Blade Beyblade in ''Beyblade X'', using the idea that she has been holding on prior to joining Persona. ===Generic/Replica Beys=== *'''[[List of Generic Beyblades in Beyblade X|Helm Knight 3-80N]]''': A generic Beyblade owned by Nine. *'''[[WizardArrow 4-80B|Arrow Wizard 4-80B]]''': Nine's replica of [[Multi Nana-iro]]'s Arrow Wizard, used to face off with Jaxon during Persona's fan meet-up event. ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} *{{Special Move|Hyper Boost Apocalypse Requiem}} ==Beybattles== ===Anime=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! She fights with her ''Pegasus'' Beyblades. She is the mother of [[Tenka Shiroboshi]] and former instructor of the [[Shiroboshi School]]. ==Appearance== Omega is a tall woman with pink/lavender hair that she keeps in a topknot, and magenta eyes patterned in a flower. Her atttire consist of a white dress with a tailcape with gold edges. She wears a star decoration band with two swords tied to her waist. She wears a mask with white wings on the left side of the mask. ==Personality== Omega Shiroboshi is a rebellious ex-instructor of the Shiroboshi School and leader of Team Zodiac. Banished for defying the dojo’s no-X-Tower rule, she became a dominant Pro Blader (champion of Solidus Tower) and the central villain of Season 2. Driven by a desire to prove the absolute supremacy of her style and gain control over the Blading world, she is ambitious, scheming, highly confident, and unafraid to bend or break rules. Her strained but still present mother-daughter dynamic with Tenka adds emotional depth to her antagonism—she wants power above all, even if it costs her family ties. In short, she’s a proud, calculating force of nature who turns tradition into a weapon for dominance. ==Biography== Omega Shiroboshi began as a dedicated instructor at the traditional Shiroboshi School and loving mother to Tenka, but her defiance of the dojo's no-X-Tower rule led to her banishment. Embracing the pro world, she became Solidus Tower champion, leader of Team Zodiac, and a dominant force with her Aero/Blast Pegasus Beyblades. Driven to prove the absolute supremacy of the Shiroboshi Style through events like the Star Battle, she positioned herself as Season 2's main antagonist—scheming, powerful, and unapologetic. Her strained mother-daughter dynamic with Tenka adds emotional layers, turning their clashes into deeply personal battles. By Season 3, her active role diminishes as the next generation (including Tenka) steps forward, but her rebellion leaves a lasting impact on the Blading world as the first major female antagonist who turned tradition into a weapon for dominance. ===Background=== Omega is a member of the 3-person team [[Zodiac]]. She was later revealed to be the mother of [[Tenka Shiroboshi|Tenka]] and the former insturctor of the Shiroboshi School. Due to her rebelling against the Shiroboshi's rule of participating in the [[The X|X Tower]], she was banished from the school. ===''Beyblade X''=== ==Beyblades== *'''[[SamuraiSteel 5-70GF|Steel Samurai 5-70GF]]''': Omega's Unique Line Beyblade in the ''Beyblade X'' manga, prior to her rebellion against the Shiroboshi School.CoroCoro Comic June 2025 Issue, SamuraiSteel 5-70GF spread *'''[[SamuraiSaber 2-70L|Saber Samurai 2-70L]]''': Omega's Unique Line Beyblade in the ''Beyblade X'' anime, prior to her rebellion against the Shiroboshi School. *'''[[AeroPegasus 3-70A|Aero Pegasus 3-70A]]''': Omega's Unique Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X''. *'''[[PegasusBlast ATr|Blast Pegasus A Tr]]''': Omega's Custom Line Beyblade in ''Beyblade X''. ===Decks=== ====[[Beyblade X: EvoBattle]]==== *Blast Pegasus A Tr *Aero Pegasus 3-70A *Saber Samurai 2-70L ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|Glimmering Stars}} **Saber Samurai uses its four katana-shaped blades to perform this Special Move. **Blast Pegasus merges its [[Main Blade - Blast|Blast Main Blade]] and [[Assist Blade - Assault|Assault Assist Blade]] to form an aggressive shape to perform this Special Move. *{{Special Move|Shooting Star}} *{{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} **Blast Pegasus' Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Big Bang". After Blast Pegasus has lost a portion of its stamina, the sharp tip on the [[Ratchet-Integrated Bit - Turbo|Turbo Ratchet-Integrated Bit]] retracts, causing it to reaccelerate. ==Beybattles== ===Anime=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 2) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |Unknown Blader |[[Beyblade X - Episode 66|66]] |Win |- |Unknown Blader |[[Beyblade X - Episode 70|70]] |Win |- |[[Yoko Kyubi]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 93|93]] (flashback) |Win |- |Unknown Blader |[[Beyblade X - Episode 96|96]] (flashback) |Win |- |[[Million Mizu]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 97|97]] (flashback) |Win (2-0) |- |[[Tenka Shiroboshi]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 99|99]] |Win (3-0) |- |Tenka Shiroboshi |99 (flashback) |Win |- |[[Jaxon Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 100|100]] |Lose |} {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 3) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[One Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 122|122]] |Lose |} ===Manga=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext=

Cross All-Stars |JpVoice=Taihi Kimura |EnVoice=Mark Whitten |AppearAnime=[[Beyblade X - Episode 103|Bey of the Future]] |AppearManga=[[Beyblade X - Chapter 29|Two In One Bey]] }}'''One Cross''', known as {{Translation|'''One Kurosu'''|{{Ruby|黒須|くろす}}ワン|Kurosu Wan}} in Japan, is the secondary antagonist of the third season of the anime/manga series, ''[[Beyblade X (Season 3)|Beyblade X]]''. He is the eldest son of [[Zero Cross]] and fights with his Beyblades, [[BahamutBlitz BK1-50I|Blitz Bahamut BK 1-50I]] and [[GloryValkyrie LF|Glory Valkerion LF]]. ==Appearance== In the manga, One is tall with a lean muscular build, and has toned muscles including six-pack abs. He has an "X"-shaped mark on his neck, and a few bangs of his hair are shaped like an "X". His streetwear attire consists of a dark blue sleeveless top, a light blue jacket/hoodie, dark gray jeans, and black sneakers. The anime adaptation changes his appearance significantly, with his sharp jawline replaced with a flatter design. His top attire in the anime consists of a light-blue sleeveless top, and a thin hoodless black jacket with the [[Cross Corporation]] logo. His bottom attire consists of black sweatpants, with a light-blue blue stripe matching his top color, and green sneakers with an "X" on them. His muscular build is also severely reduced, with his broad shoulders and toned muscles removed. The "X"-shaped mark on his neck has also been removed. At the start of the [[Beyblade X (Season 3)|True Future Arc]] of the anime, One debuts a new outfit similar to his manga counterpart, with the same light-blue jacket hoodie and black top. He retains the physique of his previous anime appearances. ==Personality== Though he does have his flair of superiority, compared to his siblings, who are arrogant and haughty, One is calmer and friendlier, making him much easier to approach than the other members of the Cross Clan. He's greatly loyal to his [[Zero Cross|father]] and does his bidding willingly. ==Biography== ===Background=== One is the eldest child of [[Zero Cross]] of the Cross Clan, having eight other sibilings who are all talented in blading. parts.title: Own Finish Rule
parts.text:
The {{Translation|'''Own Finish Rule'''|オウンフィニッシュルール|Oun Finisshu Rūru}} was a special rule introduced by [[Takara Tomy]] during the [[X Series]]. The '''Own Finish Rule''' has only officially been used once by [[B4]], at the "Tobu Zoo Cup" Grade 2 (G2) event, held on June 15th, 2024. The '''Own Finish Rule''' was used during all event matches.<ref name="Website">[https://beyblade.takaratomy.co.jp/beyblade-x/event/g2_tobuzoocup2024.html Tobu Zoo Cup page]</ref>

==Description==
The '''Own Finish Rule''' is applied to situations where an Over Finish (normally 2 points) or Xtreme Finish (normally 3 points) is achieved without touching the opponent's Bey after the battle starts. These are instead considered an "Own Finish", and 1 point is awarded to the opponent instead of the normal 2 or 3 points. The battle is then restarted (with the same Beys).

In other words, scenarios such as launching directly into an Over Zone or Xtreme Zone is treated as an Own Finish. As the battle is restarted, Bladers do not move onto their next Beyblades in a [[3on3 Battle]] or [[Deck Battle]] match as they would from an Over or Xtreme Finish.<ref name="Website"/>

===World Beyblade Organization===
The '''Own Finish Rule''' was introduced as a rule for [[World Beyblade Organization]] (WBO) Ranked tournaments on June 10th, 2024.<ref name="Jun10">[https://worldbeyblade.org/Thread-WBO-Organized-Play-Updates-June-2024-Own-Finish--111781 WBO Organized Play Updates June 2024]</ref> This was following a proposal and poll held on May 22nd, 2024.<ref name="May22">[https://worldbeyblade.org/Thread-Proposal-Non-Contact-Self-KO-Ruled-as-%E2%80%9COwn-Finish%E2%80%9D Own Finish Rule proposal thread]</ref> Individual tournament organizers could choose to omit the '''Own Finish Rule''' from their tournaments.

On February 24th, 2025 the '''Own Finish Rule''' was removed from the WBO's core rules, and became an optional rule instead.<ref name="Feb24">[https://worldbeyblade.org/Thread-New-WBO-Beyblade-X-Rulebook-Find-Out-What%E2%80%99s-Changed New WBO Beyblade X rulebook announcement]</ref>

She is the grandmother of [[Titus Manju]]. She fights with her Beyblade, [[ShinobiShadow 1-80MN|Shadow Shinobi 1-80MN]]. ==Appearance== Quinn is a tall, elderly woman with curly gray and orange hair, a gray, orange and purple mohawk and brown eyes. She also dons black eyeliner, red lipstick and a pair of queen chess piece earrings. In her youth, her hair was styled similarly to manes of a lion. She has very long red nails. She also dons orange eyeliner, red lipstick and a pair of queen chess piece earrings. Her attire consists of a purple shirt with a logo of a lion, a long black trench coat with flower prints, a pair of flared blue jeans with flower prints and brown, pointed boots. She also often dons a yellow and white paper fan. In her youth, her attire consists of a purple shirt, a necklace with three sharp fangs, a long black trench coat with flower prints, and a pair of flared blue jeans. ==Personality== Quinn is a wise and experienced Blader with tons of knowledge and wisdom from her past battles. She is very observant during a battle, as she can predict exactly what happens before said battle even starts and can acknowledge specific Bladers as protagonists of their own story. Quinn never forgets any of her battles or her opponents, as she remembers the 9 Bladers who defeated her. ==Biography== ===Background=== A Pro Blader with a career history spanning 25 years. Her win record is 9999 wins and 9 losses. She was later revealed to be the grandmother of [[Titus Manju|Titus]]. Her "Bag of Wisdom" ability allows her to use the experience from 9999 wins to predict the outcome of a match before it even starts. ===''Beyblade X''=== She joins the All Star Bey Battle festival seeking her 10,000th victory or her 10th loss. ==Beyblades== *'''[[Knife Shinobi 4-80HN]]''': Quinn's Basic Line Beyblade in ''[[Beyblade X]]''. *'''[[ShinobiShadow 1-80MN|Shadow Shinobi 1-80MN]]''': Quinn's Unique Line Beyblade in ''[[Beyblade X]]''. ===Decks=== ====[[Beyblade X: Xone]]==== *Shadow Shinobi 1-80MN *Beat Tyranno 1-60A *Claw Leon 4-70Q ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|The Shadow that Cannot Be Touched}} *'''[[Xtreme Dash]]''': The gears on the Beyblade's "Bit" interact with the gears on the "X-Celerator Rail" ("Xtreme Line") of the [[Xtreme Stadium]], increasing the Beyblade's speed. **Shadow Shinobi's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "A Knife Thrust from the Shadow". Following an Xtreme Dash, it strikes the opponent with multiple afterimages. ==Beybattles== ===Anime=== {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 1) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Jaxon Cross]] (Blader X) |[[Beyblade X - Episode 38|38]]-[[Beyblade X - Episode 39|39]] |Lose (0-3) |- |Unknown Blader |38 |Win |- |Unknown Blader |38 |Win |- |[[Titus Manju]] |39 (flashback) |Win |- |[[Khrome Ryugu]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 43|43]] (flashback) |Lose (0-3) |} {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 2) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[Ciel Kaminari]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 54|54]] |Win |- |[[Tenka Shiroboshi]] |54 |Lose |- |[[Titus Manju]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 79|79]] |Win (2-0) |- |[[Yoko Kyubi]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 91|91]] |Lose (0-2) |} {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Beyblade X (Season 3) |- !Opponent !Episode !Result |- |[[One Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Episode 124|124]] |Lose (0-2) |} {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Show" data-collapsetext="Hide" style="width:100%" |- ! colspan="3" style="background-color:#36badf; color:white;" |Manga |- !Opponent !Chapter !Result |- |[[Jaxon Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 11|11]] |Lose (0-2) |- |[[One Cross]] |[[Beyblade X - Chapter 33|33]] |Lose |} ==Official Description== No discussion of Blading history would be complete without mention of this living legend. Quinn Manju’s been Blading on the Pro-level since the founding of Beyblade and boasts a record of 9999 wins and only 9 losses. <onlyinclude>By slanting the launch angle and using its tall height, Lance Knight is able to attack the opposing Bey from above to make a powerful [[Force Smash]] attack.</onlyinclude>

It debuted in Japan with the release of the BX-23 Starter, [[PhoenixWing 9-60GF]], on December 10th, 2023. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Soar Phoenix Deluxe String Launcher Set]]. ==Description== The '''9-60''' Ratchet features 9 protrusions at a 6.0 millimeter height. Compared to previous Ratchets, the protrusions of '''9-60''' are narrower and do not protrude outwards as much. '''9-60''' has lower Burst risk than other 60 height Ratchets due to its smaller protrusions and low height, which reduce the amount of Ratchet contact with the opponent. G2350 (Hasbro) |Classification=Ratchet-Integrated Bit |Type=Attack |Weight=12.7 grams |System=Custom Line |Series=Beyblade X (Season 2) |ReleaseJP=July 19th, 2025 |ReleaseUS=May 15th, 2026 |ReleaseCA=July 15th, 2026 |AttackStat=30 > 55 |DefenseStat=30 > 20 |StaminaStat=60 > 10 |DashStat=10 > 45 |BurstResistanceStat=30 |HeightStat=90 > 65 |XStandard=✔️ }}{{Translation|'''Turbo'''|ターボ|Tābo}} is a [[Ratchet-Integrated Bit]] released by [[Takara Tomy]] as part of the [[Custom Line]] system. It debuted in Japan with the release of the CX-07 Starter, [[PegasusBlast ATr]], on July 19th, 2025. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s [[Clip & Rip Launcher Set]]. ==Description== '''Turbo''' is an Attack Type Ratchet-Integrated Bit, and the first ever released. As the name suggests, the Ratchet and Bit are combined into a single part. When '''Turbo''' is launched, centripetal force causes two sliders to move outwards, pushing out a thin sharp tip that produces high Stamina. When spin velocity lowers, this sharp tip retracts, and the flat edges of '''Turbo''' act as the contact point with the Stadium floor, creating aggressive movement, which makes it easier to contact the Xtreme Line (X-Celerator Rail) to perform the [[Xtreme Dash]] gimmick. While the toy's mode change is advertised by as "reaccelerating", in practice there is no Stamina (or speed) regained, and the gimmick activation actually uses up Stamina. Due to the relatively low spin velocities required for the gimmick to activate, the movement and Xtreme Dashes produced are too weak to reliably knock out or Burst the opponent. ==Overall== ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== * CX-07 [[PegasusBlast ATr]] * CX-00 [[PegasusBlast ATr]] ===Hasbro=== * G2350 [[Clip & Rip Launcher Set]] - [[Blast Pegasus A Tr]] ==Gallery== RatchetBitTurbo.png|Turbo (CX-07/G2350) ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Custom Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

It debuted in Japan with the release of the UX-19 Starter, [[BulletGriffon H]], on April 25th, 2026. It later debuted in western countries with the release of [[Hasbro]]'s Infinity Starter Pack, [[Rocket Griffon H]]. ==Description== '''Rocket Griffon''' (Japanese: '''BulletGriffon''') is a Balance Type Blade with a round shape. The Gear Chip features a [[wikipedia:Griffin|griffon]]. As part of the ''[[Unique Line]]'', '''BulletGriffon''' has plastic Launcher Hooks instead of metal ones, which increase Outward Weight Distribution (OWD). In addition, it features an Unique Line gimmick: the '''BulletGriffon''' Blade consists of 2 halves, an upper part (called the "''Bullet''"/"''Rocket''") and a lower part (called the "''Griffon''" main body). During battle, a hit will trigger the mechanism, splitting '''BulletGriffon'''. The Attack-type ''Bullet'' consists of the Blade's jagged contact points, and a flat tip. The Defense-type ''Griffon'' consists of a round perimeter, and is meant to be used with Defense-type Bits. It is also part of the ''[[Expand Blade]]'' (''Infinity'') lineup, with the expanded feature being the Ratchet integration with the Blade. ===Rulings=== The gimmick activation is not a Burst. If a '''BulletGriffon''' combo splits apart, only the lower part, called ''Griffon'', can be finished. In other words, the opponent must outspin, Burst, or knockout ''Griffon'' to win. The upper part, ''Bullet'', is considered an additional piece of the Beyblade. Therefore, even if ''Bullet'' stops spinning or is knocked out, ''Griffon'' (and the '''BulletGriffon''' combo as a whole) is still in play. Conversely, if ''Griffon'' Bursts, is knocked out, or stops spinning, the '''BulletGriffon''' combo loses. If the ''Bullet'' exits the stadium through the opening in the stadium, or through a wall, then the battle is restarted. ==Products== ===Takara Tomy=== *UX-19 [[BulletGriffon H]] ===Hasbro=== *G4561 [[Rocket Griffon H]] ==Gallery== RatchetBladeBulletGriffon.png|BulletGriffon (UX-19/G4561) BulletGriffon H (Bullet).png|''Bullet'' upper part BulletGriffon H (Main Body).png|''Griffon'' main body lower part ==Trivia== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Parts}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]

[[Custom Grip (Beyblade X)|Custom Grip]] |JpVoice = [[wikipedia:Shūichirō Umeda|Shūichirō Umeda]] |EnVoice = Caleb Yen |AppearAnime = [[Beyblade X - Episode 01|X]] |AppearManga = [[Beyblade X - Chapter 01|X]] }}'''Robin Kazami''', known as {{Translation|'''Bird Kazami'''|{{Ruby|風|かざ}}{{Ruby|見|み}}バード|Kazami Bādo|Kazami Bird}} in Japan, is the leader of [[Persona]], the protagonist team of the anime/manga series, ''[[Beyblade X (Season 1)|Beyblade X]]''. Robin originally fought alongside [[Strike Hawk]] [[Strike Hawk 4-80LF|4-80LF]] before it was destroyed by [[Takumi Ishiyama]]. After meeting [[Multi Nana-iro]], he began using ''Incendio'' Beys that she crafted. ==Appearance== Robin is an average-sized boy with red eyes with a yellow crystal shape on the irises and brown messy hair that is normally held up by a long yellow headband and is styled similar to feathers of a bird. His attire consists of a red jacket with a silver zipper, a black tank top underneath it, a brown belt, black pants, black socks and red shoes with orange laces and brown soles. ==Personality== Robin Kazami, is portrayed as a determined and ambitious individual. As the leader of Team Persona and an aspiring pro Blader, Robin moves to Xenon City with the dream of becoming a professional blader, demonstrating his strong ambition and drive to reach the top of the blading world. His role as the team leader also suggests qualities of leadership and responsibility, although there are discussions about his effectiveness. Despite potential criticisms, Robin's involvement with former champion Jaxon Cross and influencer Multi Nana-iro indicates he works well within a team and can collaborate towards shared goals. Robin is characterized by his kind, supportive and fun-loving personality. Despite facing a long losing streak in battles, he remains resilient, always training and improving, embodying the spirit of perseverance. He is also a supportive teammate, lifting up his friends and finding joy in the journey of Beyblade. Additionally, he has a talent for cooking, particularly sushi, which he uses to bring joy to others. ==Biography== ===Background=== Robin, along with his teammates [[Suzaki]] and [[Tsuru]], were undefeated in their hometown.''[[Beyblade X]]'' Episode 1, ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 01|X]]'' Their team, [[Albatross]], won several district tournaments.''[[Beyblade X]]'' [[Beyblade X - Special Chapter 01|Prologue Chapter]] After watching [[Khrome Ryugu]]'s match on the final floor of [[The X]], Robin was inspired to become a Pro Blader and eventually traveled to [[Xenon City]] with Suzaki and Tsuru. Robin has a notably high degree of athletic prowess''[[Beyblade X]]'' Episode 14, ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 14|Jax-ercise]]'', with several sports teams in his hometown asking him to join them''[[Beyblade X]]'' Episode 19, ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 19|Zip and Zoom]]'', including basketball, football, baseball, swimming, weightlifting and track. Robin is also highly adept at cooking and prepares meals in several episodes. Robin is particularly gifted at sushi making, and enters a different state of mind when he makes sushi.''[[Beyblade X]]'' Episode 20, ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 20|Memories of Sushi]]'' Robin's "ultimate sushi" brought [[Taisho Sushiya|Taisho]] to tears and nearly caused Myoden to faint, prompting the former to declare Robin would inherit [[Komaba Sushi]] (to which Robin declined). Robin has also demonstrated a high degree of skill in fighting games, defeating [[Quinn Manju]] 10 times, despite the latter having a high win record.''[[Beyblade X]]'' Episode 42, ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 42|XYZ]]'' Robin has also demonstrated strong observational skills and a remarkable aptitude for learning. After watching Jaxon and Blaze's battle, he was also able to replicate Jaxon's Xtreme Dash Infinite (in the manga)[[Beyblade X - Chapter 08|'''Proof of the Fastest''']], and after Jaxon and Khrome's battle during the title match, he was also able to replicate Khrome's "Dragonic Break" technique in his match against Ciel simply out of wanting to do it himself.''[[Beyblade X (Season 1)|Beyblade X]]'' Episode 51, ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 51|The Most Fun Ever]]'' Furthermore, b

She fights with her Beyblade, [[HeavensRing 0-80DS|Ring Aether 0-80DS]]. ==Appearance== Seven is an tall girl with short dark green hair and blue eyes. In her physical appearance, she can be seen wearing a black long-sleeved turtleneck shirt with a heart and a cherub and tan pants. In her 4X Persona, she depicts herself with long blonde hair with two pink hair streaks, green eyes with pink eyeshadow, and pink lipstick applied on her bottom lip. She wears a white dress with detachable sleeves that covers her arms and a cross-shaped collar, a halo ring with 2 crosses on each end, a pair of blue pants with white linings and brown shoes. She is also accompanied by seven cute cherubs, each colored in red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple and pink. ==Personality== Seven is shown to be a hikikomori, rarely leaving her room and using her 4X Persona to interact with the outside world. Her bubbly personality is just a mask for her true colours as an arrogant Blader, like many of her siblings, and she loves to taunt her opponents. However, she tends to get furious and panic when things don't go her way. ==Biography== ===Background=== ===''Beyblade X''=== Seven is one of the nine children of [[Zero Cross]] of the Cross family. According to [[Nine Cross|Nine]], she might be the most dangerous if someone gets on her bad side.[[Beyblade X - Chapter 35]]''[[Beyblade X (Season 3)|Beyblade X]]'' Episode 124 - ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 124|True X Tower War]]'' Unlike her siblings, Seven rarely makes public appearances. She fights with her Beyblade, [[WeissTiger 3-60U|Pearl Tiger 3-60U]]. She is also the older sister of [[Multi Nana-iro]]. In Season 3, Sigrid is entrusted with [[WolfHunt F0-60DB|Hunt Wolf F 0-60DB]] by [[Ginro]] to take down the Cross Family. Multi then helps her to customize it into [[WolfHunt F4-60T|Hunt Wolf F 4-60T]]. ==Appearance== Sigrid is a tall young woman with dark skin, grey eyes with cream mascara and lavender eyeliner, and waist-length hair that is split between sky blue, cream, and lavender. Her attire consists of a purple long-sleeved shirt, a gray ribbon headband, a black leather jacket, black pants, a brown belt and brown boots with sky blue soles. ==Personality== Sigrid has a dry tone of speech. She tends to be blunt and straightforward when she speaks her mind. Due to her immense strength, she doesn't hesitate to call other Bladers weak, including her own sister. Despite her demeanor, she is often polite and courteous. Like Jaxon, Sigrid enjoys eating sushi, particularly from [[Komaba Sushi]]. ==Biography== ===Background=== When Sigrid was little she was the opposite of her younger sister, [[Multi Nana-iro|Multi]] who was talented in multiple categories. After Multi started Beyblade, Sigrid didn't show any interest in Beyblading. Until one day when someone was bullying Multi and other bladers after defeating them. Sigrid then showed up and decided to borrow Multi's bey as all the other beys weren't the right bey for Sigrid, despite having never used a bey before and it being her first time beyblading she won against the bully. While walking home with Multi, she didn't know why she was so strong but had a fun time and asked Multi if she would beyblade with her. After several battles where Multi has used several different beys and tactics. Later after Multi became a Bey Crafter, Sigrid was given a prototype bey model of Scythe Incendio. However, as time passed, defeating Multi 10,000 consecutive times cause the sister's relationship to strain. Upon being asked to go pro, Sigrid would have to leave home and live in a blading house by the industry. She spoke to Multi first, later during her trial period with Khrome having lost against him, her bey was declared not top-tier enough to use by the executive director. Going over what Multi said she made her decision, the next morning after being given her new bey [[WeissTiger 3-60U|Pearl Tiger]], she packed up her bags and she left home.''[[Beyblade X]]'' Chapter 09 ''[[Beyblade X - Chapter 09|A Rainbow Guest]]'' and Episode 44 [[Beyblade X - Episode 44|''Family, Back Then'']] She would join Team [[Pendragon]] after being invited, upon debuting as a Pro Blader at sametime she also debuted as a model.''[[Beyblade X]]'' Episode 43 ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 43|Pendragon, Back Then]]'' ===''Beyblade X''=== ==Beyblades== ===Primary Beys=== *'''[[HellsScythe 4-60T|Scythe Incendio 4-60T]]''': The prototype was the first Beyblade Multi had ever crafted and was made specifically for Sigrid. Multi later finished a completed version, intending to give it to Sigrid. However, Sigrid left to join Pendragon, where she was given Pearl Tiger, and thus Sigrid did not see or use the completed Bey. Multi would later give the completed Scythe Incendio to [[Robin Kazami]], with Sigrid borrowing it from him in the episode ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 34|A Rainbow Guest]]''. *'''[[WeissTiger 3-60U|Pearl Tiger 3-60U]]''': Sigrid's primary Basic Line Beyblade in ''[[Beyblade X (Season 1)|Beyblade X]]''. *'''[[WolfHunt F4-60T|Hunt Wolf F 4-60T]]''': Sigrid's primary Custom Line Beyblade, which was borrowed and entrusted by Ginro, as well as customized by Multi using the [[Ratchet - 4-60|4-60 Ratchet]] and the [[Bit - Taper|Taper Bit]] from Robin's Scythe Incendio. **It is added with the suffix "Balance Custom". ===Generic/Borrowed Beys=== *'''[[LeonClaw 5-60T|Claw Leon 5-60T]]''': Borrowed by Sigrid from Multi for her first battle. *'''[[WolfHunt F0-60DB|Hunt Wolf F 0-60DB]]''': Borrowed and entrusted by Ginro in ''[[Beyblade X - Episode 104|The Wolf and the Sun]]''. ===Decks=== ====[[Beyblade X: Xone]] & [[Beyblade X: EvoBattle|EvoBattle]]==== *Pearl Tiger 3-60U *Scythe Incendio 4-60T *Hammer Incendio 3-70GP ===Special Moves=== *{{Special Move|Xtreme Dash}} **Scythe Incendio's Xtreme Dash uses the suffix "Crescent Judgment".
